title: Statistical & Regulatory Reporting Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Summary:

Support the Company’s statistical and regulatory reporting function, with primary responsibility for preparing accurate and timely state regulatory data calls and assisting with policy-level statistical reporting, reinsurance reporting, data quality monitoring, internal controls, and related external reporting. Work closely with the Statistical & Regulatory Reporting Manager, Corporate Finance, field operations, Information Systems, and other stakeholders to compile, validate, reconcile, document, and submit required information. Contribute to process improvement and automation efforts using available reporting and analytical tools.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

This role has four primary areas of responsibility:

1. Support ORT Statistical Reporting Function

  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc statistical reports using policy-level data and other Company information.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliations, and quality control reviews to support the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of policy and statistical reporting.
  • Assist with monitoring unmatched policies, large commercial policies, and other policy-reporting exceptions. Research variances and escalate significant issues to the Manager.
  • Coordinate with field operations and Information Systems to obtain data, resolve reporting issues, and promote consistent policy-entry and reporting practices.
  • Assist in maintaining reporting instructions, data definitions, procedures, workpapers, and supporting documentation.
  • Support preparation of training materials and communications for field offices regarding policy reporting standards and process changes.
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of reports and key performance indicators related to policy production, unmatched policies, statistical data, and other policy metrics.
  • undefined
  • Support State Regulatory Reporting Effort for ORT
    • Prepare and file annual state regulatory data calls and other recurring regulatory submissions under the direction of the Manager.
    • Prepare responses to ad hoc data requests from state insurance departments and other regulatory bodies.
    • Research filing instructions and changes in state, NAIC, and other applicable reporting requirements and summarize potential impacts for review by the Manager.
    • Maintain filing calendars, status tracking, supporting documentation, and evidence of review and submission.
    • Assist with regulatory inquiries, market conduct examinations, and related requests involving statistical or policy-level data.
    • undefined
    • Support Reinsurance Reporting
      • Assist with preparation of quarterly and annual reinsurance reporting packages provided to the Company’s third-party reinsurance broker and other stakeholders.
      • Reconcile reinsurance data to applicable source systems and financial records and investigate and document differences.
      • Prepare supporting schedules, workpapers, and responses to follow-up questions related to reinsurance reporting.
      • undefined
      • Support External Reporting and Process Improvement Efforts
        • Perform assigned internal controls over statistical, regulatory, and reinsurance reporting and retain appropriate documentation.
        • Identify data-quality, control, or process issues and communicate them promptly to the Manager.
        • Assist with testing and implementation of system enhancements, regulatory changes, and process improvements that reduce manual effort and improve reporting reliability.
        • Use Microsoft Excel and available reporting tools, which may include Workday, OfficeConnect, Adaptive Planning, and Power BI, to compile, analyze, reconcile, and present information.
        • Assist in developing and maintaining automated dashboards that provide visibility into policy production, unmatched policies, key performance indicators, and reinsurance metrics.
        • Assist with recurring and ad hoc reporting to the parent company, regulators, rating agencies, auditors, and other internal or external stakeholders.
        • Support industry, competitor, and rating-agency analyses by compiling and validating requested information.
        • Provide limited assistance with GAAP and statutory financial reporting when statistical, policy, reinsurance, or regulatory data is required.
        • Perform various special projects and analyses, as required.
    • Essential Duties and Responsibilities Continued:
      • Complies with Company policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and completes mandatory Company compliance training by prescribed deadlines.
      • At a minimum, the ability to work scheduled office hours, Monday through Friday. Extended working hours may be necessary in connection with required filing and reporting deadlines.
      • Dependable, reliable, and punctual attendance is required, which may include attendance at after-hour Company events.
      • Ability to accept supervision as well as constructive feedback.
      • Other duties that may be assigned.
      • undefined Knowledge and Skills Required: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field required. A minimum of two years of relevant experience in accounting, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, insurance operations, data analysis, or a related discipline preferred. Working knowledge of general accounting principles. Exposure to GAAP, statutory accounting, insurance regulatory reporting, or policy-level reporting is preferred. Strong analytical and mathematical aptitude, with the ability to reconcile large or complex data sets, identify exceptions, and document conclusions. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Microsoft Excel. Experience with Workday Financials, OfficeConnect, Adaptive Planning, Power BI, CoPilot, databases, or other reporting tools is a plus. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while successfully performing under tight time constraints and meeting prescribed deadlines. Strong attention to detail, with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and projects. Ability to prepare and maintain organized workpapers and supporting documentation and to maintain current knowledge of applicable accounting and regulatory requirements. Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent professional written, verbal, listening, and communication skills. Must be a personable, positive, and professional representative of the Company. Ability to foster, develop, and maintain professional and collaborative working relationships. Must be able to work effectively with peers, employees, supervisors, outside customers, regulators, auditors, and vendors. Ability to collaborate and interact effectively and professionally with all levels of management and employees by email, phone, video conference, and in person. Demonstrates courtesy and professionalism and is proactive and responsive to supervisor, coworker, and customer needs and expectations. Actively listens and communicates clearly and respectfully. title: Määräaikainen postityöntekijä, Tammisaari
description:
We at Posti take care of a smoother flow of everyday life for you, companies and society while building a more sustainable future for us all with a diverse pool of professionals from mail deliverers and warehouse workers to artificial intelligence experts. As a large company, the range of possibilities we offer is huge – also internationally. Overall, we have 13,000 experts across the Nordics and Baltics. Join us to create the future Posti!

Tule postityöntekijäksi Tammisaareen!

Postinjakajan työ on vaihtelevaa ja liikkuvaa ulkotyötä. Työssä toimitat posti ja paketit asiakkaille perille saakka. Olet jakelureitilläsi Postin näkyvin edustaja, ja jakajamme palvelevat päivittäin lähes kaikkia suomalaisia kotitalouksia ja yrityksiä. Työssä yhdistyvät reipas tekeminen sekä luottamukselliset ja ystävälliset asiakassuhteet. Työtä tehdään erilaisilla alueilla, kuten maaseudulla ja taajamassa, varauduthan kulkemaan myös kerrostalorapuissa.

Työvälineet: Käytössäsi on Postin auto, joten onhan sinulla B-ajokortti ja reilusti ajokokemusta.


Työaika ja -sopimus: Työt sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiville. Työsopimus on kokoaikainen ja määräaikainen, viikkotyötunnit ovat 38,25 h/vko. Työtä on tarjolla ajanjaksoille 5.10.2026-31.12.2026

Palkkaus: 13,14€/tunti (alkaen) Viestinvälitys- ja logistiikka-alan työehtosopimuksen P-liitteen mukainen.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää
  • Reipasta itsenäistä työotetta, asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, täsmällisyyttä ja luotettavuutta
  • Itsenäinen työskentely on sinulle mieluisaa
  • Viihdyt ulkoilmassa – sateella ja paisteella
  • Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja suomen kielen taitoa
  • Vähintään B-ajokortti ja 2 vuotta ajokokemusta
  • Ruotsinkielinen taito välttämätön

Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin?

Meillä pääset osaksi yritystä, jonka toiminta vaikuttaa miljoonien ihmisten jokapäiväiseen elämään. Olemme kasvaneet kansainväliseksi logistiikan moniosaajaksi ja toimimme myös Pohjoismaissa ja Baltiassa. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta teknologiaa, ja olemme edelläkävijöitä kestävämmän tulevaisuuden rakentamisessa.

Edistämme monimuotoista ja yhdenvertaista työelämää. Kaikki esihenkilömme käyvät läpi Välittävä johtaja -koulutuksen, ja yhdessä rakennamme välittävää työkulttuuria. Työturvallisuus on meille tärkeä osa jokapäiväistä toimintaamme ja sen jatkuva kehittäminen on myös osoitus siitä, että välitämme.


Tulisitko sinä meidän työkaveriksi? Jätäthän hakemuksesi järjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pikaisesti, mutta viimeistään 2.10.2026 mennessä. Haastattelemme potentiaalisia hakijoita jo hakuaikana.


Arvostamme työyhteisössä monimuotoisuutta, yhdenvertaisuutta ja mukaan ottamista. Toivomme hakijoita erilaisista taustoista, kuten eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.


Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

Our common values – reliable, respectful, progressive - guide everything we do. Read more!

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Procurement

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About LPSD

The Large Power Systems Division (LPSD) is part of Caterpillar’s Power & Energy segment. Through this global organization, Caterpillar designs and manufacture large (greater than 18 liters) diesel and natural gas engines, powertrains and key engine systems. LPSD products and solutions support customers across power generation, industrial, marine, oil & gas, rail, services and Cat® machine applications worldwide.


Job Summary

We are seeking a Supplier Development Engineer. This person will assess the supplier quality and ensure that all the products are free from defects and are in compliance with manufacturing specifications and legal standards.


What you will do:

  • Ensuring the quality of supplies by conducting tests and assessments on incoming supplies to identify any quality issues; Developing supplier inspection, testing, and evaluation mechanism.
  • Generating reports on supplier quality, by monitoring their defect rates and areas that can lead to potential flaws; Guiding suppliers to reduce these defect rates.
  • Researching the potential vendors, assessing their manufacturing environment, practices, and procedures; Conducting supplier quality control audits to ensure compliance with organizational and federal policies and standards.
  • Supporting suppliers in improving their performance through process enhancements, implementing process controls, and developing quality assurance plans.

What you will have:

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
  • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
  • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
  • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Streamlines the critical workflow for executing key processes.
  • Sets priorities for addressing process problems that limit performance.
  • Develops methods for improving and establishing controls for critical processes.
  • Monitors external sources for applicable new methods and controls.
  • Analyzes findings from improvement cycles to ensure success of interventions.
  • Coaches others to develop the skills to improve processes.

Manufacturing Standards, Procedures and Policies: Knowledge of organizational standards, procedures and policies in manufacturing activities; ability to plan, guide, and monitor manufacturing processes for compliance.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ensures communication vehicles are effectively informing affected areas and personnel.
  • Consults on development and implementation of cross-functional standards.
  • Participates in the development of organizational policies and practices.
  • Develops and uses control and monitoring mechanisms for adherence.
  • Collaborates with other functions on establishing and documenting joint standards.
  • Participates in defining architectural principles and standards for organization.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Facilitates supplier partnering arrangements that share risk and reward.
  • Monitors supplier performance; works to resolve discrepancies between performance and agreements.
  • Develops quality standards and controls for suppliers.
  • Builds and maintains partnerships with multiple and/or large suppliers.
  • Evaluates issues and terminates supplier relationships as appropriate; works with legal departments.
  • Ensures the fulfillment of report and record-keeping requirements.

Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying vendors, suppliers and partners.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates potential suppliers for a wide variety of products.
  • Develops a preferred suppliers list for selection and evaluation.
  • Designs key aspects of and processes for evaluating a supplier's capabilities.
  • Compares and contrasts alternative methods and tools for the evaluation of organizations and products.
  • Analyzes and resolves supplier product quality, support, or pricing problems.
  • Works with multiple evaluation, selection, and certification initiatives.

Top Candidates May Have:

  • Manufacturing Experience – Experience running machinery, evaluating machinery, setting up machinery, troubleshooting machinery, etc.
  • ASQ Certification

Additional Information

  • This position may require travel up to 30% of the time

$112,710.00 - $169,060.00

BENEFITS INFORMATION:

For information on Sysco’s Benefits, please visit https://SyscoBenefits.com

SUMMARY

Performs timely and accurate cycle counts of inventory, completes correct inventory adjustments and performs inventory control activities for the purpose of maintaining accuracy at the item and location level. Performs all duties safely, accurately and meets set productivity goals.


Shift:

Monday through Friday

7:30 AM - 4:00 PM


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform quarterly cycle counting of inventory to ensure accuracy of perpetual inventory including product information (lot tracking and date integrity), product condition (damage/spoilage), stock location (mis-picks), proper location and pick slotting and any other inventory status specification.
  • Make accurate cycle count adjustments in the Warehouse Management System (WMS) as required to provide correct information for planning and evaluation activities.
  • Communicate detailed information for any potential loss of inventory (expiration, temp issues, etc.) to Manager, Inventory Control or Director, Warehouse Operations to ensure timely action on volatile inventory.
  • Correct any product found in the incorrect storage location during cycle counts, complete a Quality Incident Packet indicating the associate who mis-located the product and provide to operations for associate follow up.

Determine required inventory adjustment and input data into WMS to provide accurate information for planning and evaluation activities. title: Sr Manager, IT Project Manager
description:
Job Description:

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position


IT Project Manager

Role Overview

The IT Project Manager supports one or more technology projects and/or delivery teams, partnering with product, program, and engineering/technology leaders to embed modern iterative delivery practices and principles into day-to-day work. This includes planning, tracking, and managing project and team work, including dependencies, risks, releases, and status updates. They are accountable for assessing project priorities and ensuring project delivery. They do so by modeling Fidelity leadership behaviors and adaptive ways of working, helping to evolve and sustain an innovative, collaborative culture.

Key Responsibilities

Planning and Coordination

  • Ensure project scope, objectives, and roadmaps are aligned with product, business, and technology strategies.
  • Manage multiple projects of low-to-medium size or complexity, or a single project with high visibility, complexity, and/or risk.
  • Partner with product, program, and technology leaders to create plans, identify risks and dependencies, and develop release schedules.
  • Maintain project documentation and ensure transparency through structured communication channels.

Execution and Delivery Management

  • Lead and manage events to support backlog prioritization, planning, and execution across multiple projects or complex initiatives.
  • Track and report delivery health to stakeholders using leading and lagging indicators.
  • Facilitate trade-off discussions using empirical delivery data to ensure successful delivery.
  • Drive shared accountability for delivery against capacity, quality standards, and business value.
  • Identify, manage, and communicate risks and dependencies.
  • Coordinate internal and external communications and training plans to support project execution.

Continuous Improvement and Predictability

  • Implement and refine delivery processes using data insights and historical trends to improve predictability and efficiency.
  • Optimize workflows and work sequencing for continuous delivery and reduced context switching.
  • Find opportunities for lifecycle-based strategy updates and process improvements.

Technology and Quality Oversight

  • Enforce engineering excellence by managing quality standards, technical debt, incidents, and change processes.
  • Ensure effective, integrated release management, including readiness across teams and clear communication.

Team Leadership and Culture

  • Motivate and guide teams by fostering a culture of ownership and accountability.
  • Support team formation, training, and continuous improvement through feedback and learning opportunities.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–7 years of experience in project or delivery management roles.
  • Experience supporting technology delivery teams in a large enterprise environment.

Project and Professional Capabilities

  • Project Planning & Roadmap Development – Ability to define scope, objectives, and timelines aligned with business goals.
  • Delivery Management – Expertise in managing schedules, resources, and budgets for complex projects.
  • Risk & Dependency Management – Skill in identifying risks, managing dependencies, and ensuring release readiness.
  • Data-Driven Process Improvement – Ability to use metrics and trends to optimize delivery predictability and efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Communication & Influence – Providing transparency and aligning diverse stakeholders.
  • Performance Monitoring & KPI Management – Tracking delivery health and reporting progress against milestones.
  • Change Leadership & Adaptability – Driving adoption of modern delivery practices and fostering innovation.
  • Iterative Delivery Frameworks – Deep understanding of frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, and Six Sigma.
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Knowledge – Deep understanding of the phases of software delivery, from requirements through deployment, and the broader implications of challenges across the lifecycle.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

title: Pharmacy Professional Practice Coordinator
description:
Overview

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington. With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality. At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

The Pharmacy Professional Practice Coordinator is a senior Pharmacist and acts as an integral member of Fred Hutch patient care services, providing pharmacotherapeutic recommendations to providers, nursing, research staff, and other members of the health care team to optimize patient care. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to providing research, education and professional pharmacy practice management for the assigned pharmacy practice area and/or assigned patient population.

Depending on area of assignment, the Pharmacy Practice Manager may provide direct patient care, drug dispensing in addition to the practice management duties.

At Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, all employees are expected to demonstrate a commitment to our values of collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity, and respect.

This is a Full-Time role working Monday thru Friday from 8 to 5.

Responsibilities

Practice Management

  • Implement and maintain departmental policies and procedures related to the safe and effective use of medications
  • Routinely evaluate current updates in service specific literature
  • Develop and maintain drug therapy monitoring systems for patients
  • Establish and maintain efficient lines of communication between pharmacists, physicians, nurses and other members of the health care team.
  • Participate in pharmacy and hospital committees as requested
  • Participate in the development and implementation of quality assurance programs for pharmacy services, including, but not limited to, prevention of medication errors
  • Perform drug utilization evaluation and cost containment analyses, as neededEducation
  • Provide primary preceptorship of pharmacy residents and student pharmacists
  • Provide education to medical/surgical residents, nursing staff and medical students
  • Present at educational conferences to multidisciplinary staff, as requested
  • Develop and provide nursing in-services
  • Provide didactic teaching to student pharmacists at the University of Washington School of Pharmacy, as requestedResearch
  • Participate in collaborative research projects with healthcare professionals, pharmacy residents and student pharmacists.
  • Submit unique work for publication in professional journals
  • May assist in the preparation, review and implementation of drug study protocols
  • Collaborating with investigators in support of investigational drug studiesClinicalMay be assigned Senior Pharmacist clinical responsibilities for an assigned patient care area, including:
  • Collaborate with providers to individualize drug therapies promoting safe, effective and economical patient care.
  • Perform comprehensive medication therapy review and other activities as necessary to ensure safe transitions of care.
  • Assume responsibility for monitoring and modifying the drug regimen when referred, to include the ordering and interpretation of laboratory testing.
  • Provide refill authorization in conjunction with assessment of adherence, disease states, drug interactions, efficacy, and safety.
  • Act as a drug information resource to providers, nursing staff, research staff and patients.
  • Ensure patient access to specialty medications by assisting with providing required clinical information to insurers when needed.
  • Identify patients with indications for drug therapy who are under-treated and optimize drug therapy.
  • Identify barriers to adherence to medication regimen, incorporating patient characteristics i.e. language, culture/religious practices, physical, cognitive, emotional, pain/discomfort, socioeconomic status.
  • Utilize tools in educating the patient on self-management of disease and drug therapy.
  • Review clinic prescribing patterns with clinic staff to design targeted education to promote consistency with UWP guidelines (or other nationally recognized guidelines when needed)
  • The pharmacist may manage anticoagulation therapy, infectious disease therapy, complementary and alternative therapy, or pain/palliative care for clinic patients under a collaborative drug therapy agreement. Patient care activities include management of all aspects of therapy including initiation, patient education, short term and long term monitoring and management, care transitions, and consults.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Graduation from an accredited School of Pharmacy
  • Two years of experience in pharmacy practice (months spent in the completion of an American Society of Health-System Pharmacists accredited residency training program may substitute month-for-month for the experience)
  • State of Washington Pharmacist License

Preferred:

  • Doctor of pharmacy (PharmD) degree, or equivalent, from an accredited School of Pharmacy

Pre Employment Drug Screening:

As a condition of employment Fred Hutch conducts pre-employment drug testing for this pharmacy role. All offers of employment in the pharmacy department are conditional on the applicant successfully completing and passing a drug test in accordance with the Fred Hutch policy.

The annual base salary range for this position is from $156,832.00 to $261,352.00, and pay offered will be based on experience and qualifications. This is a Full-Time role working Monday thru Friday from 8 to 5. Although Fred Hutch is not sponsoring most H-1B visas at this time, candidates who already hold an H-1B sponsored by another organization and are currently in the U.S. may be eligible for this position. Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center offers employees a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits include medical/vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, life, disability, retirement, family life support, employee assistance program, onsite health clinic, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation (12-22 days per year), paid sick leave (12-25 days per year), paid holidays (13 days per year), paid parental leave (up to 4 weeks).

Additional Information

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, political ideology, or membership in any other legally protected class. We desire priority referrals of protected veterans. If due to a disability you need assistance/and or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to Human Resources at hrops@fredhutch.org or by calling 206-667-4700.

description:

title: Teamleader Maintenance (2pl)
description:

TVH is een gespecialiseerde leverancier van hoogwaardige onderdelen en accessoires voor material handling, industriële voertuigen en bouw- en landbouwmachines. title: Estimator II
description:
Whether you’re a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

Why Rosendin?

Committed. Innovative. Engaged.

If you’re looking to take career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. Rosendin is one of the largest electrical contractors in the United States employing over 7,000 people. We are the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED company in the industry which means you will be a company owner too and have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.

YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:

The Estimator II is a mid-level professional responsible for preparing and completing bid documents and cost estimates for electrical construction projects. The Estimator II solves a range of straightforward problems and assembles construction costs by collecting and studying information, evaluating bid specifications and drawings, to ensure they understand what is required to bid on and win the project successfully, and can present the project cost to Senior leadership. With moderate guidance and direction, the Estimator II provides overall support for small- to medium-sized projects, assisted by a senior-level estimator.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Review proposal specifications and drawings to determine the scope of work and requirements.

  • Prepare estimates by calculating the complete takeoff of the scope of work and entering them into the computer estimating system; review the estimate printout for accuracy and completeness.

  • Identify qualified suppliers/subcontractors and solicit quotes. Review quotes for completeness according to plans and specifications.

  • Itemize and quantify all incidentals necessary in preparing the bid packages, including sub-contract work, equipment rental, tools, and supplies.

  • Provide guidance to personnel preparing the completion matrix discipline for assigned bids.

  • In conjunction with Senior Estimators, develop labor productivity and (installation unit costs where applicable) based on projected site conditions and historical data.

  • Compile and execute the scope of work, address technical requirements and pricing, then present them to the Lead Estimator, Estimating Manager, and/or Chief Estimator for the estimated bid package.

  • After the successful bid, at project turnover, meet with the project management team along with the senior-level estimator to fully explain the estimate, scope of work, quotes, and offer aspects for the successful transition of the project.

  • Responsible for the timely completion of all client-required documents.

  • Prepare scope letter inclusions, exclusions, and clarifications for estimates.

  • Maintain files of working documents for backup to estimating assumptions and methodologies.

  • The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the position role within the business unit.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

  • Advanced knowledge of the assigned discipline, construction technology, estimating techniques, and cost control

  • Interpret computerized cost data and electrical systems

  • Perform arithmetic calculations required for estimating

  • Read and interpret engineering design drawings, specifications, and front-end documents

  • Identify and meet customers’ needs expectations and requirements

  • Solve practical problems and deal with a variety of specific variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

  • Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.)

  • Prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary

  • Work under time pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude

  • Oral and written communication skills as required for the position

  • Self-motivated and can work independently and as part of a team

  • Interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others

WHAT YOU BRING TO US:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field

  • Minimum 3 years of experience estimating commercial construction projects, preferably in electrical construction

  • Proficient in Accubid estimating

  • Proficient in CAD or 3D software preferred

  • Can be a combination of education, training, and relevant experience

TRAVEL:

  • Up to 10%

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • General work environment – sitting for long periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions.
  • Noise level is usually low to medium; it can be loud on the jobsite.
  • We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions.
  • Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.

YOU Matter – Our Benefits

  • Term Life, AD&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance

THIS IS A GRANT FUNDED POSITION.


The Pima County Community & Workforce Development Department has an opening for a Community & Workforce Technician II who will work as a receptionist and provide administrative assistance for both the front reception and the resource rooms at the different Pima County One-Stop locations.


Driving is only required for commuting to work; however, the position requires regular rotation between multiple work sites, some of which are not accessible by bus.


Community & Workforce Development Department works with vulnerable populations and minors. A Level one Fingerprint Clearance Card, a Criminal History Self Disclosure Affidavit, and a Central Registry background check are requirements for employment.


Essential Functions:


As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.


  • Provides detailed information and assistance to the public, clients, and staff regarding departmental programs, procedures, and eligibility requirements;
  • Handles multi-line telephone and in-person inquiries, independently resolving routine issues and referring complex matters to appropriate staff;
  • Reviews, verifies, and processes applications, forms, and related documents for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with program standards;
  • Enters, updates, and maintains program and client data in specialized databases, ensuring data integrity and generating reports as required;
  • Establishes, organizes, and maintains electronic and manual filing systems to ensure accurate recordkeeping and timely document retrieval;
  • Prepares, edits, and proofreads correspondence, reports, and other technical or administrative materials using various software applications;
  • Coordinates the scheduling of meetings, interviews, and events, preparing necessary materials and tracking related follow-up actions;
  • Provides training or guidance to clerical and support staff on office procedures and program documentation requirements;
  • Operates a variety of office equipment and systems, ensuring efficient workflow and compliance with departmental administrative standards;
  • Greets and welcomes customers and visitors in a professional and courteous manner;
  • Assesses customer needs and provides appropriate information, assistance, and direction to services, staff, programs, or resources;
  • Serves as a knowledgeable resource for customers by providing information regarding department programs, workforce services, workshops, employment resources, community services, and partner agencies;
  • Assists customers with computers, internet access, online job searches, employment websites, online applications, account access, document preparation, printing, scanning, and other technology-related needs.

Minimum Qualifications:


High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) from an accredited institution AND two years of experience performing clerical, administrative or customer service tasks providing support to a department, specialized program, or small/medium sized business.


(Relevant experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)


OR:


One year with Pima County in a Community & Workforce Technician I or related position as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment.


Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

Preferred Qualifications: (Be specific in describing your experience in your application. Ensure the descriptions provided illustrate your competencies, specifically addressing the required and preferred qualifications.):


  • Minimum one (1) year experience in a customer service desk environment or customer service-related field.
  • Minimum six (6) months experience in a social services setting.
  • Minimum one (1) year experience performing data entry.
  • Minimum one (1) year experience using Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish - speaking, reading, writing).

Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.


Supplemental Information:


Licenses and Certificates: Valid driver license is required at time of application. Valid AZ driver license is required at time of appointment. The successful applicant will be subject to a 39-month DOT Motor Vehicle Record review to determine applicant’s suitability to operate county vehicles in accordance with Pima County administrative procedures. Failure to obtain and maintain the required licenses and certifications shall be grounds for termination. Any offer of employment resulting from this recruitment is contingent upon Fleet Services’ review and approval of the candidate’s driving record.

Special Notice Items: This position requires a Level 1 fingerprint clearance card from the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County. Action Activity - none; Motion Activity - simple and firm grasping, fine movement; Hearing Activity - none; Speaking Activity - in person, on the phone; Vision - may be required to operate a motor vehicle, distinguish colors, have depth perception and peripheral vision.


Working Conditions: Works regular shifts at multiple locations throughout Pima County as directed by the department. Other working conditions will be determined by position.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

title: Rengasasentaja
description:
Rengasasentaja

Oletko asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja käytännönläheisestä työstä nauttiva tekijä? Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme rengasasentajaa rengaspalveluiden ja rengashotellin monipuolisiin tehtäviin. Työ sopii henkilölle, jolla on teknistä ymmärrystä autoista ja halu työskennellä osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

Työtehtävät:

* Renkaiden asennus ja irrotus vanteilta
* Renkaiden tasapainotus, ilmanpaineiden mittaus ja säätö
* Alumiinivanteiden asennus sekä momenttiavaimen käyttö oikeiden kiristysmomenttien varmistamiseksi
* Rengashotelliin liittyvät tehtävät, kuten rengassarjojen käsittely, pesu, tarkastus ja varastointi
* Asiakaspalvelu sekä yhteistyö korjaamon muun henkilöstön kanssa

Tarjoamme:

* Monipuolisen ja käytännönläheisen työn autoalan parissa
* Kokoaikaisen päivätyön klo 9-17, määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen
* Osaavan työyhteisön sekä nykyaikaiset työvälineet
* Vaihtelevan ja aktiivisen työympäristön
* Palkkaus tehtävässä määräytyy TES:n, osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan asettuen arviolta 13,50-15 e/h välille

Odotamme sinulta:

* Kokemusta renkaiden ja vanteiden käsittelystä
* Hyviä tiimityö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
* Huolellista, ahkeraa ja vastuullista työotetta
* Vähintään 18 vuoden ikää ja voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja hyvää fyysistä kuntoa

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Ilonalle p. 050 3589561 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

title: Scientific Director
description:
We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

The Scientific Director will lead and shape the strategic direction of our IME (Independent Medical Education) and scientific content solutions. You'll be responsible for developing evidence-based content strategies, therapeutic area plans, and educational program concepts that drive customer engagement and revenue growth across the healthcare, life sciences, and pharmaceutical markets. You'll bring medical judgment and credibility to the review, structuring, and quality of IME-related content and clinical evidence products, while also acting as a content strategist — defining how we source, structure, and scale trustworthy medical and scientific content across our portfolio.


The role combines scientific expertise, market insight, and customer-facing leadership to identify emerging healthcare trends, align Wiley assets to market needs, and design scalable content and education solutions for sponsors.


You'll work closely with key opinion leaders, project managers, product teams, and commercial sales teams to ensure our IME and science content meets the highest standards of clinical accuracy, defensibility, and usability.


Our content spans a range of health and science disciplines, including:

Health: Dentistry, Dermatology, General & Internal Medicine, Hematology, Medical Science, Neurology, Nursing, and Oncology.

Science: Analytical Chemistry, Biopharmaceuticals & Pharmaceutical Biotechnology, Cell & Molecular Biology, and Chemistry.


How You Will Make an Impact

  • Provide clinical leadership and oversight for IME and scientific content solutions, ensuring content is accurate, current, evidence-based, and defensible within medico-legal environments.
  • Shape and drive the content strategy for our IME and science portfolio, establishing quality standards, content models, and scalable review processes that support business growth and customer needs.
  • Serve as a trusted clinical expert and escalation point for complex content decisions, bringing medical judgment and credibility to high-impact initiatives.
  • Partner with editorial, product, and commercial teams to develop innovative content and educational solutions that enhance customer engagement across healthcare, life sciences, and pharmaceutical markets.
  • Monitor emerging clinical evidence, healthcare trends, regulatory developments, and IME best practices to ensure our content remains relevant, authoritative, and competitive.
  • Represent Wiley's clinical expertise with internal stakeholders, key opinion leaders, customers, and industry partners, helping strengthen our reputation as a trusted source of scientific and medical knowledge.
  • Translate complex clinical and scientific concepts into accessible, actionable content that supports learning, decision-making, and improved outcomes for healthcare professionals and researchers.

What We Look For

Required Qualifications

  • PhD, MD, or equivalent medical degree.
  • Direct experience conducting or reviewing Independent Medical Examinations (IMEs), or comparable clinical review experience.
  • Strong understanding of clinical evidence, guideline development, and the evaluation of scientific literature.
  • Experience in content strategy, editorial, medical affairs, medical communications, or a related healthcare field.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex clinical concepts to both clinical and non-clinical audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with experience working across matrixed organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Clinical expertise in oncology, hematology, dermatology, neurology, general/internal medicine, or a related specialty.
  • Familiarity with scientific disciplines such as analytical chemistry, biopharmaceuticals, pharmaceutical biotechnology, or cell and molecular biology.
  • 5+ years of experience in content strategy, medical communications, or editorial leadership.
  • Experience designing content operations, taxonomy frameworks, or structured content models.
  • Familiarity with AI- or ML-enabled content workflows, including content extraction, quality scoring, and summarization.
  • Experience within scientific, technical, and medical (STM) publishing, health information, or clinical evidence services.

We power infinite possibilities.


For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.


Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.


Job Summary:


This position is responsible for performing activities to support analytical testing programs at Bora Biologics to ensure compliance with cGMP standards including in-process, product release and stability testing. This individual will guide and partner with lower level QC analysts to provide feedback and technical information. This individual will also ensure accurate documentation, timely completion of all analytical related testing, and timely review of data, while adhering to standard operating procedures and cGMPs.


Essential Functions:

Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Responsibilities and Job Duties

  • Performs routine analytical testing including complex methods such as ELISA, bioassays, and Cell Culture as well as basic methods such as concentration by UV absorbance, pH, conductivity, and osmolality, for in process, product release, and stability samples on a daily basis in accordance with all protocols and procedures. Enters data into Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
  • Performs peer review of test data generated by other analysts to identify discrepancies and out of range results and to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and GMPs. Identifies analytical data trends and reports findings and provides recommendation to supervisors for review and consideration.
  • Conducts investigation when there are out of specification results from testing and reports to supervisor.
  • Initiates and monitors progress of analytical related Quality event records(e.g., Deviations and CAPAs) and conducts investigations to determine root cause and possible resolution.
  • Develops, revises, and updates standard operating procedures, as needed.
  • Collaborates with Senior QC team members to participate in the development, transfer, and validation of analytical testing methods and conducts training on analytical test methods to other QC Analysts as needed.
  • Overseas lab equipment calibration and maintenance processes as required for testing per standard operating procedures, and raises any concerns about equipment to supervisor for resolution.
  • Participates in troubleshooting of analytical test methods and instruments, as needed.
  • Performs special projects related to problems encountered with analytical testing and instruments, and makes recommendations for solutions that will minimize future issues.
  • Mentors and trains lower lever analysts, as needed.
  • Prepares general lab solutions and buffers as needed and monitors expirations of these solutions and buffers.

MINIMUM EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS


Education: Minimal formal education required ( Bachelor’s Degree)

Experience: Minimum number of 4 years of experience is required

Knowledge: GMP: potency and residual testings and/or GLP ELISA, Bioassay, Quality Control.

environment.

evaluation of intangible variables.

evaluation criteria for obtaining results.

title: Powder Coat Line Worker
description:
JOB SUMMARY
This position's primary function is to hang, process, and inspect parts throughout the powder coat line, ensuring all products meet quality standards before and after the coating process, while packing finished goods, and performing physical tasks in a demanding environment.
Responsibilities include:
  • Lifting, hanging, and unhanging parts on a motorized conveyor line, requiring the ability to lift up to 65 lbs.
  • Working in high-temperature conditions, including summer heat reaching 110-115 degrees Fahrenheit
  • Blowing out water from parts after the wash cycle and prior to the powder coat process
  • Performing 100% visual inspection of all products before hanging on the powder coat line, identifying defects such as rust, missing welds, or other issues that may compromise the integrity of the powder coat process
  • Performing 100% visual inspection of all finished products before placing on skids for packing
  • Packing all finished products on skids according to job-specific requirements
  • Completing all job tasks in a timely manner while meeting established production quotas
  • Performing additional tasks as assigned by management
PRINCIPAL CONTACTS INSIDE/OUTSIDE THE COMPANY
This position interacts with shop employees and management.
COMPETENCY OR POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  • Must be able to lift 65+ lbs. repeatedly throughout the duration of the shift
  • Ability to work in extreme heat conditions, including temperatures reaching 110-115 degrees Fahrenheit
  • Forklift operation
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control awareness
  • Effective communication skills
  • Time management skills and ability to meet production quotas
  • Adequate math skills; including the ability to add, subtract, and multiply
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment
  • Physical stamina and endurance to perform repetitive tasks throughout the shift All Armor employees are also expected to demonstrate Armor’s core values of being:
    • Customer-Focused
    • Passionate about Work
    • Solution-Oriented
    • Driven by Integrity
EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE
  • High school diploma or GED
  • 1+ years of experience working in a warehouse environment
EQUIPMENT USED
This position requires the use of various equipment, including a forklift, hand dollies, measuring tools, a calculator, and various lift-assisting devices, as well as powder coat line machinery and related tools used throughout the coating and inspection process.
WORKING AND PHYSICAL CONDITIONS
This position will work on the warehouse floor and lifting, climbing, standing, walking, and kneeling are required.

title: Reliability Technician
description:
Position Summary

Seeking a highly engaged, motivated individual that embraces change and challenge.

This position will assist the reliability team by focusing on preventative and predictive maintenance and measurements such as equipment lubrication, vibration measurement, and temperature measurement. They will report to the Reliability Supervisor and will be responsible for analyzing and trending data collected to predict equipment maintenance needs throughout the plant and perform failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA). This position will execute assigned work while following all applicable safety standards and best practices.

Safety and housekeeping are the first considerations in all activities. The successful candidate must consistently demonstrate an understanding of all plant & departmental safety rules, standards, and programs. This position will also assist with condition-based monitoring (CBM) routes for vibration, lubrication and oil sampling for analysis based on equipment criticality.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Perform Storeroom Clerk and Planner duties as needed.

2. Participate in LEAN events (5S, Kaizen, A3) to support plant reliability initiatives.

3. Assist with managing the weekly RPM work schedule.

4. Assist with weekly RPM meetings.

5. Collect and enter equipment hours into EAM.

6. Monitor vendor managed inventory and coordinate with vendors.

7. Assist with reviewing, VWIs, job plans, and PMs.

8. Catalog and assign barcodes for new parts into EAM.

9. Coordinate order tracking and research parts required for job plans.

10. Maintain equipment library and bill of materials.

11. Active role in day-to-day execution and documentation of planned and predictive maintenance.

12. Support continuous improvement of the plant preventative maintenance and MRO materials programs.

13. Apply FMEA and Root Cause Failure Analysis to determine need for improved maintenance strategies.

14. Coordinate maintenance activities with the Production Maintenance Coordinators (PMCs) to ensure timely repairs are made.

15. Implement predictive maintenance programs including vibration, infrared, oil analysis, and ultrasonic testing.

16. Assist CI department with documenting plant CI projects.

17. Primary responsibility for ensuring physical, electrical, and mechanical asset health and reliability is maintained.

18. Maintain a clean, color, and shape coded lubrication storage facility.

19. Perform routine skilled plant and equipment inspections, reporting any deficiencies that would lead to mechanical breakdowns, safety risks, or delays in production.

20. Use EAM for work identification, entering work requests, updating equipment history, and creating/updating PM tasks associated with preventative and/or predictive maintenance.

Experience

· Previous experience in maintenance or a reliability-focused position required.

Required Skills

1. Reading, writing, and math comprehension including calculation/measurement of volumes needed including ability to interpret manuals, drawings, reports, and lubrication analysis

2. Demonstrate initiative and strong work habits, detail oriented, able to multi-task, and have capability to effectively work under direct and indirect supervision

3. Efficiently operate with basic computer skills including Windows, Microsoft Office, EAM, and navigate the network drive along with the ability to learn new advanced software programs.

4. Must have good equipment and manufacturing knowledge with power transmission devices including gear drives and belt drives, various rotating mechanical equipment including belt conveyors, screw conveyors, and bucket elevators.

5. Knowledge of bearings, gears, pistons, oils, greases, seals, vents, breathers, filtration, power transmissions components

6. Working knowledge of the different types of reducers, their internals and applications.

7. Working knowledge of the different types of bearings, applications and lubrication requirements.

8. Capable of researching vendor prints and OEM specifications for bearings/reducers to determine correct lubrication required.

9. Demonstrate the ability to cooperate with other workers in the areas of safety, quality, and production/maintenance and understand the importance of completing assigned tasks and their relationship to other requirements.

10. Must be able to perform the essential physical requirements necessary for this job area, which may include lifting items 49 pounds or less, working in extreme temperatures, and navigating uneven terrain, ramps, steps and ladders.

11. Can effectively and efficiently communicate both written and orally with production, maintenance, managers, and all other necessary personnel including vendors.

12. Responsible for maintaining a set of personal tools as required by the engineering department.

Hourly Pay: $45.75

This is a role for someone who can operate with autonomy in an emerging, high-opportunity area.

New business development is a key aspect of this role — success depends as much on generating and closing net-new accounts as on growing existing relationships.

The Community Health Worker III (CHW III) supports Pima County’s Environmental Health efforts by serving as a senior level community liaison, educator, and navigator for residents impacted by water contamination, specifically trichloroethylene (TCE) exposure associated with the Tucson International Airport Area (TIAA) Superfund site.


This position will plan and implement initiatives and community based activities around environmental health contaminants. It provides advanced community based support, conducts outreach in historically affected neighborhoods, assists residents in understanding environmental exposures, and connects individuals to health, social, and environmental resources. The CHW III plays a vital role in building community trust, supporting environmental justice priorities, and ensuring residents have access to accurate information, culturally relevant education, and pathways to care and assistance.

As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics.   • Works with clients facing complex health and social challenges, providing intensive case management and support;
  • Advocates for systemic changes and policy improvements that positively impact community health outcomes;
  • Leads quality improvement initiatives within the community health team, identifying opportunities for enhancement;
  • Implements strategies to ensure the delivery of high-quality and culturally competent services;
  • Stays informed about emerging public health trends, evidence-based practices, and community resources.

High school diploma or equivalent AND four (4) years of experience in community work, education, or working as a community health worker (CHW) or representative (CHR) AND certified as a CHW or CHR from an accredited program. Certification must be provided at the time of application.

  • Experience collaborating with community-based organizations, researchers, and/or healthcare institutions.

Job Description:

The Senior Coordinator for Experiential Learning Programs provides leadership and oversight for a portfolio of co-curricular and experiential learning initiatives that strengthen student engagement, belonging, professional development, and connection to the Fulton Schools of Engineering. The incumbent in this role will primarily work with the Grand Challenges Scholars Program, Engineering Projects in Community Service, and the Fulton Accelerate Community Engagement programs. The position also includes responsibilities spanning the Student Success and Engagement team related to project management, assessment, evaluation, and reporting.

The position is responsible for managing multiple programs and initiatives, coordinating faculty and stakeholder partnerships, supervising professional and student staff, and leading efforts related to assessment, continuous improvement, and strategic growth. The Senior Coordinator serves as a leader within Student Success and Engagement and is responsible for advancing college priorities through effective project management, implementation, and collaboration.

As a member of the Student Success and Engagement team, the coordinator, Sr. supports essential duties within E2 Camp, a cornerstone retention initiative. E2 camp is held in Prescott, Arizona, during July and August annually. This individual will be required to travel to and participate in leadership of E2 for approximately 10 days (not consecutive), which will be decided in conjunction with the individual hired.


Position Salary Range:

  • $58,000 - $64,000 per year; DOE

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Programmatic Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for a portfolio of experiential learning programs and initiatives
  • Establish annual priorities, goals, implementation plans, and success measures aligned with college and Student Success and Engagement priorities
  • Monitor participation, engagement, and program outcomes to inform decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Lead program planning, resource management, communications, and implementation efforts across the portfolio
  • Cultivate and strengthen partnerships with faculty, staff, students, and external stakeholders
  • Evaluate opportunities for program enhancement, growth, and new experiential learning initiatives that support student engagement, belonging, and professional development

Project Implementation

  • Lead project management and implementation efforts across experiential learning programs and the Student Success and Engagement team
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and deliverables to ensure successful execution of priorities and initiatives
  • Serve as a resource for project planning, implementation, and continuous improvement
  • Identify and address risks, barriers, and opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and operational effectiveness
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts supporting college and university priorities

Assessment and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead assessment and evaluation efforts across Student Success and Engagement, ensuring consistent measurement of program outcomes and impact
  • Analyze participation, engagement, and outcome data to inform decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Develop reports, presentations, and recommendations that support strategic planning and resource allocation
  • Identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness, student outcomes, and operational performance
  • Promote a culture of data-informed decision-making, assessment, and accountability across the team

Staff Leadership and Development

  • Supervise professional and student staff
  • Establish performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching
  • Support staff development and leadership growth
  • Delegate responsibilities effectively while maintaining accountability for outcomes
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement

Partnership Development

  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with faculty, academic units, university partners, industry representatives, and community organizations
  • Serve as a liaison between Student Success and Engagement and partner units
  • Facilitate collaboration across decentralized teams and stakeholder groups

Desired Qualifications

Demonstrated experience with:

  • Leading multiple programs, initiatives, or projects simultaneously
  • Managing complex projects from planning through implementation

Department Statement:

At the Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering, we are delivering a world-class learning experience for our students and advancing research and innovation — all at scale. The Fulton Schools research enterprise leads use-inspired research and key national initiatives, including the Southwest Advanced Prototyping Hub, accelerating microelectronics and workforce development for the Department of Defense. We also lead the Electrified Processes for Industry Without Carbon Clean Energy Manufacturing Institute, supported by the Department of Energy, aiming to reduce carbon emissions and strengthen manufacturing. Additionally, we lead an NSF Engineering Research Center developing sustainable civil infrastructure and partner with another ERC advancing clean water technology.


The Fulton Schools hosts numerous research centers that leverage faculty expertise to drive engineering innovation and entrepreneurship across four interdisciplinary impact areas: Climate Technology Solutions, Competitive Manufacturing in an Advanced Economy, National and Economic Security, and Technology-Enhanced Health and Medicine. Our faculty are achieving excellence at scale, positioning the Fulton Schools among the nation’s top engineering colleges for invention disclosures, U.S. patents, and startups.


We are an engineering school on the rise at the nation’s most innovative university, situated in the heart of its fastest-growing metropolitan area. The breadth of our faculty’s research interests and interdisciplinary approach, along with over 55+ graduate and 28 undergraduate degree programs, creates a strong foundation for collaboration and the advancement of ideas that contribute to a more sustainable and livable global future.

The Fulton Schools of Engineering is driven by core values that define our approach, distinguish our practice, and guide daily decisions in academics, research, corporate partnerships, and entrepreneurship. This is one continuing, full-time position that may be appointed at Academic Level C, D or E, depending on the successful candidate’s experience, track record and level of appointment sought.


The successful candidate will contribute to teaching, research, industry engagement and academic leadership in areas including communication engineering, network engineering, network security, telecommunications infrastructure, wireless and space communications, 6G and beyond, and advanced communication and networking technologies.


We are particularly interested in candidates with strong theoretical foundations and hands-on expertise in the design, development, integration and validation of telecommunications systems, including capability in areas such as software-defined radios, RFSoCs, RF and millimetre-wave systems and devices, high-speed signal processing, embedded system design, network simulators and emulators, network security simulators, and network testbeds such as ORAN.


The appointment level will be determined with reference to the candidate’s demonstrated academic achievements, research profile, teaching capability, leadership experience and alignment with the relevant Academic Level C, D or E expectations.


To be considered for appointment at Level C, you will have:

  • An emerging nationally recognised research track record in communication engineering, networks and security, 6G and beyond, aerial and space communications, including substantial research outputs in high-quality outlets.
  • Experience in the design and development of research testbeds, integrating hardware platforms and associated software systems to test, validate, and evaluate research outcomes in practical environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate large courses and deliver high-quality undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, including curriculum development, assessment design and student-centred learning improvements.
  • Experience developing and leading high-quality research projects, attracting external research funding, supervising higher degree by research candidates, and building productive research collaborations.

To be considered for appointment at Level D, you will also have:

  • A nationally recognised research track record with a substantial record of research outputs in high-quality outlets and emerging international recognition.
  • Advanced knowledge and experience in the design and development of research testbeds, integrating hardware platforms and associated software systems to test and validate research outcomes, evaluate system performance, and demonstrate engineering concepts in practical and realistic operating environments.
  • Extensive research leadership experience, including the ability to build and mentor collaborative research teams, attract and manage external research funding, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead advancement in teaching, implement program improvements, contribute to academic governance, and support scholarly development within the discipline.

To be considered for appointment at Level E, you will also have:

  • A distinguished national and internationally recognised research profile, with evidence of eminent standing and sustained contribution to the discipline.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in the design, development, and deployment of research testbeds, integrating hardware and software systems to test and validate research outcomes, demonstrate concepts in practical environments, and advance proposed solutions towards higher Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs).
  • Proven ability to establish, sustain and grow research groups, centres or major research programs through external funding, partnerships and high-impact research outputs.
  • Demonstrated strategic academic leadership, including leading teaching and research excellence, contributing to School, College and University strategy, and influencing the wider professional, industry or community sector.

Qualifications:

Mandatory for appointment at Level C, D or E: PhD in a related field or approved AQF equivalency with relevant industry experience.

Please Note: Appointment to this position is subject to passing a Working with Children and National Police Check.

Department of Electrical & Electronic Engineering

The Department of Electrical & Electronic Engineering is one of RMIT’s largest departments, with a strong reputation for research and innovation across photonics, electrification, sensors, electronic manufacturing, power and automation/control, and telecommunication systems and networks.

In 2025, the department's research grant income exceeded $17 million, with nearly $65 million secured over the past five years.

The Department leads major research initiatives including COMBS, the D2D manufacturing facility, COMAS and the national centre for electrification, and has strong engagement with defence and industry partners in RF systems, antennas, materials, space and wireless communications.

The Department delivers undergraduate and postgraduate programs across electrical, power, control and automation; analog/digital, RF and microelectronics; embedded, computer and software; and communication and networks.


The Department also delivers offshore teaching programs in Hong Kong and India and maintains strong industry partnerships across funded research, work-integrated learning, student placements and project co-supervision.
