title: Environmental Specialist
description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Environmental Specialist will be the primary responsible individual for ensuring environmental regulatory compliance at the Reworld Lake Resource Recovery Facility, in Okahumpka, FL and Pasco County Resource Recovery Facility, in Spring Hill, FL.


Individual should be well versed with Title V Air permit regulations, and the enforcement of permit conditions on a day-to-day and long-term basis. In addition, the position is the primary environmental contact between client-owner (for Pasco County) and FDEP regulators and should be knowledgeable of general facility environmental operations. Knowledge of air pollution control system operations and Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems is a plus. The Environmental Specialist is the facility representative on all compliance testing and reporting.


The Environmental Specialist supports facility management personnel in the continued operation of the facility in compliance with all regulatory procedures, including federal and state environmental regulations, production schedules, output requirements and contractual obligations.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Under limited supervision, the Environmental Specialist supports the company and corporate programs and administering policies and procedures developed to prevent, eliminate, control and reduce work-related hazards and maintain environmental responsibility. Reporting to the Facility Manager, and supported by the Regional Environmental Manager, the Environmental Specialist duties will include:


EXPERIENCE IN WASTE to ENERGY a PLUS!!!!!

  • Prepare all reports for federal, state and local regulatory bodies
  • Analyzing CEMS emissions data and writing technical notification reports.
  • Maintaining PSD and Title V operating requirements, and completing all associated Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, and Annual emission reports.
  • EPA and DOE report preparation and submittals including GHG and EIA Reporting
  • Liaison with client-owner and/or environmental regulators for audits and inspections.
  • Presentations to staff, visitors, the client/owner and regulators
  • Maintain Reworld internal reporting standards (Environmental Management Information System, root cause analysis reports, environmental key performance indicators, weekly walkdown inspection reports, etc.)
  • Proactively work with operators to resolve and prevent environmental issues, developing facility environmental procedures and training.
  • Deliver and complete environmental projects.
  • Maintenance of key environmental records and documents
  • Actively participate in environmental associations and community engagement
  • Coordinate with facility/contractors to complete permit required activities: Annual Stack Testing, Quarterly CEMS Audits, Quarterly GHG Audits, residue testing, etc.
  • Maintain strong working relationship with client-owner environmental department.
  • Assists vendors or contractors when addressing environmental systems, i.e. cylinder gas audits, annual performance tests, ash sampling, stormwater, etc.
  • Functions as a proficient environmental/regulatory specialist working within the limits of environmental permitting and compliance issues for Company operations.
  • Provides technical assistance to facility operations to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state and/or company environmental regulations.
  • Auditing of facilities such as profiled waste generators, APHIS generators, metal recyclers, and landfills
  • Extensive support to Lake Facility site QA/QC profiled waste program
  • Assist with environmental duties at other facilities throughout the region, as needed

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelors degree in engineering, environmental science, or equivalent and a minimum or 3-5 years experience in the environmental field; preferably the air (or solid waste) field.
  • A working knowledge of FL and federal environmental regulations in air required (waste and water is a plus).
  • Must have strong written and oral communications skills and demonstrate ability to work creatively within the regulatory framework.
  • Strong computer, technical, and writing skills are needed.
  • Must be able to speak, read and write in English.

title: Ammattitaitoinen teollisuusmaalari Loimaalle
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme ammattitaitoista teollisuusmaalaria vahvistamaan Loimaan tuotantotiimiä.

Haemme tekijää, jolla on kokemusta metalliosien märkämaalauksesta ja silmää laadukkaalle työnjäljelle. Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti metallikappaleiden pintakäsittelyn parissa osana tehokasta tuotantoprosessia.

* Metalliosien ripustus maalausta varten

* Kappaleiden märkämaalaus

* Maalipinnan laadun ja tasaisuuden varmistaminen

* Valmiiden tuotteiden irrotus ja pakkaus

* Muut maalaamon ja tuotannon päivittäiset työtehtävät

* Ruiskumaalauksen hallintaa

* Oma-aloitteisuutta ja reipasta asennetta työntekoon

* Valmiutta fyysiseen tuotantotyöhön

* Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä

Alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta vahva käytännön ammattitaito ja kokemus ratkaisevat.

* Palkkauksen kokemuksen mukaan 14-18€/h
* Monipuolisen työn teollisuusmaalaamossa

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi

* Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön ja hyvän perehdytyksen

title: Community Administrator

Are you a passionate leader who thrives on building strong teams, delivering exceptional resident experiences, and driving operational excellence?

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

At our community, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the lives of residents, families, and employees every day. We are committed to fostering a culture of compassion, accountability, and excellence while providing the support and resources our leaders need to succeed.

If you are an experienced senior living leader who is passionate about creating exceptional experiences and building thriving teams, we invite you to apply today.

Join us in creating a community where residents feel at home and employees feel valued.

title: Logistics Analyst
location: Hagerstown, Maryland, United States of America
description:
Logistics Analyst

Description -

Location: Fulltime onsite Hagerstown, MD


Role Summary


The Outbound Operations Lead / Analyst is the on-site expert who orchestrates all shipping activities- picking, packing, staging, loading, and system transactions within HP’s distribution operations. Blending shop-floor coordination with advanced analytics, the role ensures that every order departs safely, on time, and in full. Working side-by-side with 3PL partners, Transportation, Customer Support, and IT teams, this individual contributor drives day-to-day execution while uncovering process improvements that elevate customer experience, cost efficiency, and compliance. This position will work fulltime onsite at our east coast DC in Hagerstown, MD.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily outbound operations, ensuring accurate and timely order fulfillment, packing, and shipping in line with HP’s quality and service standards.
  • Lead and support process improvement initiatives focused on optimizing outbound flow, reducing order cycle times, minimizing shipping errors, and enhancing on-time delivery performance.
  • Collaborate with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Warehouse, IT, and Transportation teams to coordinate outbound shipments, resolve exceptions, and ensure alignment with customer requirements.
  • Track real-time metrics such as pick accuracy, order fill rate, on-time ship, trailer utilization, and dock-to-door cycle time; initiate immediate countermeasures when performance drifts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for order expedites, configuration changes, embargo checks, and any customer-facing shipment issues.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs for outbound operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform outbound quality audits- scan accuracy, weight checks, and load inspections- to prevent mis-ships and damage, driving corrective actions with 3PL floor leaders.
  • Train and coach warehouse staff on best practices for picking, packing, and shipping processes.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects related to layout optimization, packaging solutions, and supply chain transformation.
  • Analyse order, carrier, and freight-cost data to uncover waste and bottlenecks; develop dashboards and executive summaries that translate insights into actionable improvement roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in outbound or shipping operations within a distribution, fulfillment, or manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP) and familiarity with transportation processes managed through a 4PL model.
  • Proficiency with Excel plus a data-visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau; able to translate raw data into actionable insights.
  • Strong communication and influence skills; comfortable directing 3PL associates and collaborating with a remote 4PL team without direct authority.
  • Understanding of domestic parcel, LTL, and truckload shipping requirements and basic export documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a 3PL-run facility or a technology supply chain
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or APICS certification (CSCP, CPIM).
  • Exposure to CTPAT, ISO 9001, or other compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with HP’s products, distribution models, or technology sector best practices.

Pay & Benefits

opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United

States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related

knowledge, skills, and experience.

  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account

  • 11 paid holidays

  • US benefits overview https://hpbenefits.ce.alight.com/

posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems.   • 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
  • Experience with vacuum-based or wet chemistry (Plating), or dry chemistry (PVD), equipment, utilizing software-controls
  • Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
  • Must be able to work in a clean-room environment
  • Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols


Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. description:

This position reports to:

Digital Execution Lead

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with key stakeholders to develop, implement, and facilitate successful onboarding of digital solutions and the adoption of digital platforms and solutions into the customer business environment along with their subsequent operations and maintenance. Each day, you will provide consultative assistance in supporting the use of products with the goal of improving productivity and efficiency. You will also showcase your expertise by helping the customers to achieve their solution goals and objectives by leveraging domain expertise and knowledge on ABB's digital solutions.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, based either in Houston, TX or Cleveland, OH

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of Advanced Process Control (APC) applications, ensuring successful project delivery and achievement of customer performance objectives.
  • Develop and maintain dynamic process models, control strategies, and optimization solutions that improve production throughput, product quality, energy efficiency, process stability, and asset utilization.
  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for APC solutions, supporting sales pursuits, proposal development, technical workshops, scope development, and customer presentations.

  • Provide lifecycle support for deployed APC applications, including performance monitoring, controller tuning, troubleshooting, model maintenance, periodic health checks, and continuous improvement recommendations.
  • Analyze process and operational data to quantify benefits, identify optimization opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations that deliver measurable business value to customers.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and project team members while promoting APC engineering best practices, standards, and documentation quality.
  • Support the development of APC standards, methodologies, reusable engineering templates, and organizational knowledge to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability of APC project execution.
  • Guides, mentors, and performs a variety of software engineering tasks in one or more of the assigned areas such as software development, software quality engineering, software testing, DevOPS, cybersecurity, software release, support and maintenance, and/or release management with limited supervision.
  • Collaborates with Sales, Product Management, and development teams and Solution Architects for future planning, feature development, and support on product deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering with advanced degrees (Master’s or PhD) preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in industrial automation, energy, power and water and oil and gas industries.
  • Expertise in process control to develop and implement advanced control strategies for optimizing processes.

The company provides advanced defense and commercial technologies across space, air, land, sea and cyber domains. L3Harris has approximately $18 billion in annual revenue and 47,000 employees, with customers in more than 100 countries.

Job Description:

L3Harris Corporation is currently seeking a high-energy Program Manager to lead the growth and execution of Development programs within the Maritime Integrated Systems and Encryption (ISE) business. The PM will have a unique end-to-end life cycle management opportunity to leverage decades of L3Harris experience in C5ISR and Navigation & Machinery Control solutions to shape next generation solutions with customers, build a portfolio of new business, and own its profitability in execution.

The Program Manager oversees all efforts relating to contract execution and is responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring projects from beginning to end, according to strict deadlines and budgets. The Development Program Manager acts as the point-of-contact between elements of Program Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, Test, Quality, Engineering, Business Development and Finance. They ensure cost and schedule conformance on assigned projects by coordinating the procurement, build, and test of complex electronic systems. We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Program Manager to lead and support project execution while driving the implementation of Earned Value Management (EVM). This role will be responsible for ensuring program performance is accurately measured using EVM principles.

A successful candidate should be able to:

- Handle stressful situations with maturity, respect, and confidence
- Demonstrate strong interpersonal and relationship building skills
- Be a self-starter with a track record of identifying and implementing creative solutions to complex problems
- Demonstrate attention to detail with strong organizational skills
- Excel in a team environment with the ability to avoid and resolve conflict
- Interpret basic engineering instructions and drawings
- Understand various manufacturing processes and methods

Essential Functions:

- Work collaboratively with and act as primary point of contact for Customer stakeholders for each assigned L3Harris subsystem.
- Responsible for managing programs within a matrixed organization, communicating with stakeholders internal and external to the organization.
- Communicates within and outside of own function to gain cooperation on operational processes, practices, and procedures.
- Manage cost, schedule and technical performance on multiple, parallel development, production and qualification efforts.
- Develop and monitor financial forecasts for monthly, quarterly and annual reviews

- Implement EVM processes across projects to track cost, schedule, and performance metrics.
- Develop and maintain EVM baselines, including Planned Value (PV), Earned Value (EV), and Actual Cost (AC).
- Perform lead-time and critical path analysis on multi-level designs and hardware builds
- Oversee program budgets with the responsibility to analyze, manage and report on budget performance and variance analysis
- Coordinate with Master Schedulers and Master Planners to develop baseline program plans
- Coordinate resource requirements (Staffing) with subsystem Program Managers and work with functional leadership to assure that issues are addressed in a timely manner
- With functional leader support, develop the Work Breakdown Structure, project schedules, resource plans, and risk management strategies.
- Responsible for process improvement, drawing on best practices and lessons identified.
- Works alongside operations, supply chain, and engineering at various levels to complete projects and processes.
- Utilize program management tools to monitor and report program performance to objectives (including budget, schedule, and other management requirements) and facilitate program coordination and decision-making.
- Able to travel up to 10%

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience
- Experience with Cost-Plus and Fixed Price contracts and major subcontracts.
- Expert EVMS knowledge demonstrated on successful production programs.
- Demonstrated ability to lead Proposal Development and Capture efforts
- Ability to obtain a US Secret Security Clearance
- Project Management Institute (PMI) Program Management Professional (PMP) Certification or working towards certification

Preferred Additional Skills:

- Related experience in a manufacturing, production, or other highly schedule-based environment
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to analyze data using graphs and pivot tables
- Experience using schedule management tools such as Microsoft project
- Proficient in SAP, MS Office, MS Project, Cobra
- Demonstrated ability in financial or data analysis and monitoring is desired
- Experience in cost control, budgeting, and forecasting.
- Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment, facilitating collaboration between engineering, QA, and test site teams.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels

title: Quality Control Specialist (Structural)
description:
The Quality Control Specialist (Structural), is responsible for conducting detailed inspections and testing of all structural components, including earthwork, foundations, structural steel, and concrete, to ensure strict adherence to project plans, specifications, building codes, and approved shop drawings. This role is critical for verifying the safety and integrity of the project's framework.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and inspect all phases of concrete work, including formwork, rebar placement and splicing, concrete delivery ticket verification, sampling, slump testing, air content, temperature checks, and cylinder preparation for strength testing.
  • Verify the quality of structural steel erection, including member dimensions, bolted connections, torque verification, plumbs, levels, alignment, and welding inspection (visual and coordination of NDT/UT testing).
  • Oversee and document site preparation, excavation depths, soil compaction tests, sub-grade stabilization, and footing/pile cap installations.
  • Review and maintain records for all structural materials (e.g., steel mill certifications, concrete mix designs, anchor bolt certifications) to confirm they meet specified requirements.
  • Maintain comprehensive QC records, including Inspection and Test Plans, Daily Quality Reports, non-conformance reports, and deficiency lists (punch lists).
  • Ensure all work meets the requirements of the International Building Code, American Concrete Institute, American Welding Society, and project-specific technical specifications.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management or related field. Previous and relevant work experience in place of degrees is applicable
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in quality control or construction on commercial, government or industrial projects.
  • Takes initiative and personal responsibility to always deliver value and excellence
  • Uses expertise to create a vision and aligns the team to deliver/achieve desired outcomes
  • A track record of establishing/contributing to creative strategic solutions
  • Ability to communicate effectively with, persuade, and gain “buy-in” from, a broad range of stakeholders (e.g., executive team, leadership team, Business Unit Leaders, direct reports, clients, trade partners, and third-party providers
  • Alignment to Clark Standards of Excellence: self-motivated, results oriented, adaptable, team player, accountable, ethical, innovative, resilient, builds relationships, builds people/teams and followership, sets direction and executes

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.


The Physical Side of the Role: This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.


Your Work Environment: You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Your safety is our top priority, and you'll be expected to follow Clark Construction's safety policies and procedures, and all applicable laws, at all locations.


Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.


A Drug Free Workplace: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.


Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $75,000-$150,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

This position is a great way to get your foot in the door in one of the fastest growing industries in the country! Tidal Wave has immense professional development opportunities, and a great career path to management positions.

What Your Day Will Look Like:

  • Enroll customers in our Unlimited Car Wash Club.

What You Will Need:

  • Friendly, Responsible, and Reliable!
  • Ability to be on your feet for long hours at a time.
  • Willingness to work in all weather conditions.
  • Drug Screen and Background Check Required.

As a Tidal Wave Auto Spa Team Member, you will enjoy our Benefits Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:

  • PTO is based on the company’s PTO policy.
  • Eligibility for health, dental, vision, and supplemental coverage (such as life insurance, critical illness, accidental, and short/long term disability) subject to 12-month measurement period. (You must work an average of 30 or more hours a week over a 12-month period to be deemed eligible.)
  • Eligibility for 401(K), subject to plan terms.
  • Company-paid holidays.

The equal employment opportunity policy of Tidal Wave Auto Spa provides for a fair and equal employment opportunity for all associates and job applicants regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law. Tidal Wave Auto Spa hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.


About Tidal Wave Auto Spa


Tidal Wave Auto Spa is one of the fastest-growing car wash companies in the country and a recognized leader in the industry. Our journey began in 2004 in the small town of Thomaston, Georgia, where our headquarters remains today. Since then, Tidal Wave has grown into a national brand with more than 300 locations across 30 states, delivering fast, high-quality car care through innovative technology and exceptional guest service.


Our success is driven by our people. We believe great locations are built by great leaders, which is why we empower our teams to take ownership, serve their communities, deliver results, and create an environment where both employees and guests can thrive.


As Tidal Wave continues to grow, we are looking for talented, motivated individuals who are ready to grow with us. Our goal is to redefine the car wash industry through innovation, operational excellence, outstanding service, and an unwavering commitment to our employees and the communities we serve.


Recognized as one of the leading conveyor car wash companies in the country and named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s Fastest-Growing Companies, Tidal Wave continues to build on a strong foundation of growth, leadership, and community involvement. Through our charitable efforts, we have also contributed millions of dollars to organizations and causes in the communities we call home.

Join the wave and build your future with Tidal Wave Auto Spa.

title: Multi-Skilled Technician
description:

36

Psychiatric Unit

Under the delegation and supervision of the registered nurse, the multi-skilled technician will administer basic, direct and/or indirect patient care and perform various procedures and related services necessary to the care and needs of patients/customers. Performs clerical duties and other department functions as directed

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
1. Ability to accurately take and record measurements or readings.

PATIENT CENTERED CARE & BEHAVIORAL EXPECTATIONS

• Treats patients, co-workers, visitors and volunteers with courtesy, compassion, empathy and respect.
• Results oriented and focused on achievement of objectives.
• Acknowledges and responds to the diversity of people and the situation.

title: Events Logistics Officer
description:
Overview:

RMIT Vietnam is looking for an Events Logistics Officer to support the smooth delivery of university events at our Hanoi campus. This role will coordinate logistics, vendors, venues and on-site operations to ensure every event is well organised, professionally delivered and runs seamlessly from start to finish.

In line with our current recruitment and selection guidelines, this role is open to Vietnamese candidates only. Expected start date: at the earliest available opportunity.

WHY JOIN RMIT VIETNAM?

At RMIT Vietnam, international exposure meets real-world impact through strong industry and government collaboration. Working at RMIT means building a meaningful career while creating impact in a high-performing environment.

Further insight into our mission, impact and global connections is available in the RMIT Vietnam Profile.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive remuneration VND package for candidates.
  • 13th month bonus
  • Private Health insurance for you and your family, plus Personal Accident Insurance
  • Generous annual leave, sick leave, volunteer leave and public holidays (Christmas and Tet Holidays)
  • Professional development and career advancement
  • Access to state-of-the-art facilities and resources
  • A vibrant and diverse campus life and more!

POSITION SUMMARY

The Events Logistics Officer supports the planning and execution of university events in Hanoi by coordinating logistics, vendors, and operational services.

Working under the guidance of the Events Operations Specialist, the role is responsible for ensuring all logistical components, including catering, venue arrangements, entertainment, and support services, are delivered effectively and aligned with event requirements. The position plays a key role in maintaining smooth operations through detailed coordination, vendor management, and on-site support across all event phases.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES SUMMARY

Catering Coordination

  • Coordinate catering services for events, including menu selection, quantity planning, dietary requirements, and service flow, in alignment with event scale and audience profile.
  • Liaise with internal teams and catering vendors to arrange appropriate facilities and service setup (e.g. room layout, serving stations, storage, back-of-house areas).
  • Ensure catering plans align with event timelines, guest flow, and venue conditions.
  • Monitor catering setup and service delivery onsite to ensure quality, hygiene standards, and adherence to agreed scope.
  • Support coordination of any on-the-day adjustments or issues, ensuring minimal disruption to guest experience.
  • Mentor students participating in the University Events Apprentice Program by coaching on food and beverage operations, regulatory compliance, service standards, and catering logistics.

Venue, Facility & Site Services Coordination

  • Coordinate requirements for furniture, fixtures, utilities, and equipment. Liaise with Property Services and internal teams to conduct pre-event checks, ensuring all spaces and services are set up according to plan.
  • Manage the delivery of essential site services, including cleaning, parking, and medical support. Track vendor timelines to ensure alignment with the operational schedule and report any readiness issues to the Events Operation Specialist.
  • Provide active on-site coordination by assisting in the management of vendors, casual labor, and volunteers. Monitor assigned event areas to ensure smooth service delivery and positive attendee experience.
  • Assist in crowd flow observation and implement basic operational adjustments as directed. Support real-time problem-solving by coordinating with relevant parties to resolve immediate issues.
  • Support post-event pack-down and site reinstatement to ensure the venue is returned to its original condition.

Administration & On-site Operational Support

  • Handle the end-to-end administrative lifecycle for event logistics, technical equipment and supporting services, including preparing contracts, purchase requests (PR/PO), and payment documentation (Workday).
  • Prepare and maintain all operational materials, including checklists, equipment registries, and service tracking logs to ensure seamless delivery.
  • Support the sourcing, booking, and coordination of performers, talents; coordinate schedules, rehearsals, and run-of-show details to ensure smooth integration into the overall event program.
  • Arrange booking for photography and filming and on-site coordination as required.
  • Assist infrastructure setup and livestreaming production activities as required.
  • Assist the sourcing, onboarding, and performance management of outsourced labours by delivering detailed briefings, training, and operational guidelines to ensure their readiness and compliance. Build and maintain a reliable network of suppliers and workforce resources to support future event delivery
  • Act as a primary point of coordination for vendors, staff, and casual labours during event operations; monitor real-time operations to ensure all elements align with the run sheet.
  • Support the post-event review process by consolidating documentation and service records for final reporting and analysis.

KEY SELECTION CRITERIA

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline
  • Minimum 1 years’ experience in supporting event operations, logistics, or production in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to manage multiple vendors and logistics components simultaneously.
  • Good communication skills in English and Vietnamese.
  • Ability to work under pressure and adapt in dynamic event environments.
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and systems (e.g. Workday) is an advantage.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support operational decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Ability to display appropriate behaviours in line with the position, RMIT Values and RMIT Leadership Model.

For full details of the accountability, please refer to the Job Description.

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, it is mandatory to submit both a resume and a cover letter. Please click on the 'Apply' link provided in this Job Ads to initiate the application process.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the University reserves the right to appoint prior to the closing date.

Compliance Requirements

All academic appointments at RMIT Vietnam must meet University and local regulatory requirements, including English proficiency, background checks, and (for international candidates) eligibility for a work permit.

English is the language of teaching and communication at RMIT Vietnam. For this role, the minimum requirement is IELTS (General) with a score of at least 5.5 (or equivalent, as outlined in the Recruitment, Selection and Onboarding Guidelines).

Further guidance will be provided during the recruitment process.

RMIT UNIVERSITY COMMITMENT

RMIT is committed to the rights of students and staff to be safe, respected, valued, and treated as an equal in their place of study and work. All staff are expected to share this commitment and contribute to a safer community. While carrying out their role, staff are in a position of trust with students. Staff have a duty of care to report wellbeing concerns about students through the designated channels and uphold the code of conduct. RMIT Vietnam expects all staff members to comply with its Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, which relate to legal and regulatory requirements and our ways of working.

IMPORTANT NOTICE:

  • Please ensure that your application is submitted through our Workday system on the RMIT Careers page. We do not accept applications through other means.
  • RMIT Vietnam will never request any fees or payments during the application process. Be vigilant about scams asking for payment to apply.
  • For any questions or support, feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at nhu.tranngocquynh@rmit.edu.vn

Applications Close:

4 thg 10 2026 11.59 pm

We are committed to providing internationally recognised high-quality education and professional training for our students, clients and members of the community. As an internationally recognised Australian university based in Asia, RMIT Vietnam is assisting in the development of human resources capability in Vietnam and the region.

title: System Engineer
description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated, high-performing R&D Technician /Jr. Engineer to join our Greenhouse Innovation Team. This is a unique opportunity for a curious, hands-on professional who wants to go beyond standard testing to truly understand the silicon and systems you validate, while continuously learning and developing new engineering skills. You will be a key partner in the rapid prototyping and validation of next-generation Allegro technologies, contributing to innovation by translating rapid experiments into clear, data-driven insights that shape design decisions. This role is ideal for someone with an engineering mindset who thrives in fast-moving environments, offering a clear path to grow your career and broaden your impact over time.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with engineers on initial hardware bring-up and debug. Go beyond standard test execution by deeply investigating device performance to identify the “why” behind the results and uncover the root causes of complex technical challenges.

  • Support fast-moving, diverse projects by providing hands-on microelectronics assembly, board bring-up, and test execution.

  • Perform precision soldering and assembly of custom evaluation boards, load boards, and interface circuitry for test and product validation.

  • Assist in PCB and interface-circuit design; use coding/scripting (Python or MATLAB) to automate data collection and improve characterization efficiency while collaborating with engineers whenever needed.

  • Take ownership of the lab environment, ensuring benches, equipment, and storage areas are organized and meet Allegro’s high standards for safety and efficiency.
    Collaborate with the on-site team to ensure benches, cutting-edge equipment, and storage areas meet Allegro’s high standards for safety, calibration, and world-class R&D efficiency.

What You Will Need

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g., BAC+3 to BAC+5 equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Microelectronics, or a related field.

  • Electronics & Hardware Experience: Strong foundation in analog/digital electronics and microelectronic principles. Hands-on experience creating schematics, designing simple-to-moderate test/fixture PCBs, selecting components, and performing board bring-up.

  • Programming Proficiency: Comfortable scripting in Python or MATLAB to automate measurements, process data, and generate reports.

  • Lab Expertise: Hands-on experience operating oscilloscopes, source measure units, power supplies, and spectrum/network analyzers.

  • Mindset: A self-motivated, dynamic and technically curious learner who is highly organized and committed to continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Strong analytical skills with the ability to clearly document setups, procedures, and technical results.

  • Language: French C1 (professional working proficiency) required; English B2+ (spoken and written) for cross-site global collaboration.

  • Experience: Previous internships, co-ops, or hands-on experience in a laboratory or electronics R&D/test environment. Experience in the semiconductor industry is a strong plus.

Why Allegro?

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

description:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a fitness environment, including hands-on training and client interaction.

  • Proven experience leading group exercise classes and tailoring workouts for various fitness levels.

Position Purpose

This position handles all student business transactions, receives tuition and fees, enters information in the Minnesota State accounting systems and handles other payment transactions so payments are recorded and accounted for accurately. Analyzes and enters all payment transactions including cash, check, credit card and payment plans into the accounting system using correct codes and student data.


Position requires the ability to accurately handle a high volume of cash transactions and individual accounts. Complex financial aid awards and payment plans require a high level of attention to detail and knowledge of the college Business Office operations.


Daily customer service contact includes in person, answering and returning phone calls and correspondence, while answering both routine and complex questions about accounts. Work also requires regular contact with other college departments and faculty, particularly regarding student accounts.


Position Responsibilities

  • Performs cashiering duties including accepting deposit and payments from students, staff, and faculty, ensuring that funds are applied correctly, and department policy and procedures are followed.
  • Process external scholarships.
  • Process post-secondary education option students.

Salary Range:

The salary for this position is $21.12 - $28.01/hour.


(DOQ – Salary Placement will be done at time of hire.)


Minimum Qualifications (must have at time of application)

  • Two years of experience in clerical, data entry, customer service, or business-related positions.

title: Maanrakennustyöntekijä
description:
Maanrakennustyöntekijä vesi- ja viemärilinjoille Turku–Raisio-alueelle

Haemme asiakkaallemme Turun ja Raision seudulle ammattitaitoista ja itsenäiseen työhön kykenevää maanrakennustyöntekijää. Työmaat sijaitsevat Turun, Raision ja näiden lähikuntien alueella vaihtelevissa infra- ja maanrakennuskohteissa.


Työnkuva

Päivittäinen työsi painottuu vahvasti kunnallisteknisiin töihin, erityisesti vesi- ja viemäriputkien asennuksiin. Vastaat putkikaivantojen koroista, kaadoista ja asennusten tarkkuudesta, joten taso- ja putkilaserin käyttö on olennainen osa työpäivääsi. Työskentelet tiiviissä ja saumattomassa yhteistyössä kaivinkoneenkuljettajan sekä muun työmaatiimin kanssa varmistaen, että työt etenevät laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa.


Odotamme sinulta

* Vankkaa aiempaa työkokemusta maanrakennusalalta ja erityisesti vesi- ja viemäriputkien asennustöistä.

* Sujuvaa rutiinia ja osaamista taso- ja putkilaserin käytöstä.

* Kykyä lukea työmaata ja hahmottaa kunnallisteknisiä kokonaisuuksia.

* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia (tieturvakortti katsotaan eduksi).

* Reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja vastuuntuntoista asennetta – arvostamme tekijää, joka pitää lapiot ja laserit heilumassa oma-aloitteisesti.


Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

* Mielenkiintoiset ja paikalliset työmaat: Työkohteet sijaitsevat järkevien etäisyyksien päässä Turun ja Raision talousalueella.

* Vastuullisen roolin: Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi itsenäisesti osana osaavaa työryhmää.

* Reilun palkan: Palkka maksetaan infra-alan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti, aiempi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi huomioiden.

* Luotettavan työnantajan tuen: Taustallasi on kokenut tiimi, joka huolehtii asioistasi.

Työsuhde solmitaan henkilöstövuokrausyritys WE Rekry Oy:n kanssa. Työnantajana vastaamme kaikista työnantajavelvoitteista, ja saat meiltä täyden tuen työsuhteesi aikana.


Kiinnostuitko?

Käsittelemme hakemuksia nopealla aikataululla jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan ammattilaisen löydyttyä. Toimi siis pikaisesti!

Hakeminen: Laita hakemus linkistä tai lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: eino.merentie@werekry.fi

title: Senior Technician (Textiles-Knitting)
description:
**Overall Purpose**

A Knitting Technician is required within the University’s teaching area and laboratory, ensuring continuity of technical and teaching support for students and academic staff during the period of absence. The role is essential to the safe and effective operation of knitting machinery, equipment and associated facilities, as well as supporting the delivery of practical classes and maintaining a high-quality learning environment.

The overall purpose of the role is to provide technical support and contribute to the delivery of classes, including preparing and maintaining equipment, demonstrating knitting techniques and machinery, guiding and supporting students during practical sessions, and providing technical advice for student projects. The postholder will also ensure that equipment and facilities are appropriately maintained and that relevant health and safety procedures are followed within the teaching laboratory.

The Knitting Technician will provide technical and teaching support within the University’s teaching area and laboratory, delivering practical classes and demonstrations in knitting. They will support students and academic staff with the use of knitting machinery, equipment and materials, assist with student projects, and ensure the teaching environment is safe, well-organised and fit for purpose.

The role holder will use their knowledge and practical experience of knitting technologies to deliver engaging and effective practical classes, demonstrations and one-to-one support. They will prepare equipment and materials in advance of teaching, maintain and troubleshoot knitting machinery, provide guidance on techniques and processes, and work collaboratively with academic colleagues to support the delivery of the curriculum. They will also ensure appropriate health and safety procedures are followed and that equipment is maintained to a suitable standard.

The role will ensure continuity of high-quality technical teaching and student support during maternity leave, enabling students to develop practical, technical and creative skills with confidence. The postholder will make a direct contribution to the student learning experience by providing expertise, facilitating access to industry-relevant equipment and techniques, and helping students successfully realise their creative and academic projects.

Employee Engagement & People Insights

Employee Relations & Risk Management

title: Senior Metallurgical Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description:

The Laboratory/Support Senior Engineer position will provide advanced metallurgical and materials engineering expertise to support Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, and Supplier Quality organizations. This role is essential for ensuring products meet Caterpillar specifications while minimizing quality risks, production disruptions, and warranty exposure.

The position will deliver value by providing technical leadership in the investigation and resolution of complex quality issues involving materials, heat treatment, manufacturing processes, and supplier components.

Job Duties/Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide metallurgical validation and technical engineering support for New Product Introduction (NPI) projects and Technical Services activities, contributing to quality, manufacturing, and new product launch objectives.
  • Lead the resolution of complex heat treatment and coating-related issues in collaboration with customers and internal manufacturing organizations, minimizing quality risks and potential warranty exposure.
  • Lead the execution of capital projects for laboratory and manufacturing improvements, focused on enhancing technical and operational capabilities.
  • Provide metallurgical validation and technical oversight for outsourced heat treatment operations ensuring compliance with technical requirements, quality standards, and specifications.
  • Develop and deliver metallurgy training programs focused on specifications, heat treatment, welding, acid etch analysis, and failure prevention for operators, engineers, and technicians, exceeding 120 man-hours of training annually.
  • Create and maintain technical procedures, engineering standards, and laboratory documentation based on Caterpillar and international standards, including 1E Specifications, ASTM, AISI-SAE, and ISO requirements.
  • Drive laboratory equipment reliability and preventive maintenance initiatives to achieve uninterrupted support for manufacturing operations.
  • Manage metallurgical laboratory operations, including budgeting, procurement, equipment maintenance, and resource allocation, ensuring operational efficiency, resource availability, and cost control.

Skill Descriptors:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

• Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights.
• Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs.
• Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy.
• Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned.
• Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
• Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
• Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
• Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
• Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.


Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
• Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
• Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
• Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
• Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

Product Testing: Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of manufacturing.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Documents test process and results; prepares and analyzes defect-tracking reports.
• Summarizes features of a specific product-testing process and associated procedures.
• Tests components for compliance with functional requirements and established conventions.
• Discusses and compares usability, safety and integration testing.
• Develops product-testing procedures; participates in selecting testing environment and tools.

Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing or product development environment.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Documents common hardware, software and communications problems and likely resolutions.
• Troubleshoots typical technical problems in a specific area.
• Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities to discover application problems.
• Adheres to standard troubleshooting procedures to ensure effectiveness of resolutions.
• Participates in setting evaluation standards and criterion for troubleshooting.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS degree in Materials/Metallurgical Engineering
  • Fluent English level, written and oral communication
  • Minimum 2 years of experience around Heat Treat or Metallurgical environment
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented problem solving and prioritization skills
  • Previous experience in technical problem solving
  • Excellent mechanical aptitude
  • undefined

Desired Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in similar industries, for example automotive, glass, gear manufacturing or metal processing industries
  • Project management experience
  • Experience with ferrous heat treatment processes such as carburizing, direct hardening, tempering, and annealing.
  • Prior experience creating and maintaining quality plans, including FMEAs, Control Plans, SPC skills, etc.

Knowledge of controls for heat treat processes (atmosphere control, heating time/rate, quench media controls, scan rate, etc.)

September 25, 2026 - October 1, 2026

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
What success looks like in this role:

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage automated Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions leveraging Azure Bicep and Azure Verified Modules (AVM) to deploy, configure, and standardize enterprise landing zones and workload infrastructure.
  • Provision, maintain, and automate core enterprise networking architectures, including Azure Virtual WAN (VWAN), Virtual Hubs (VHUB), VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Route Tables, and Private Endpoints/Private DNS Zones.
  • Manage application traffic routing, SSL offloading, and secure entry points using Azure Application Gateway (App GW) / WAF.
  • Support compute and storage lifecycles by automating the deployment and configuration of Azure Virtual Machines (VMs), Storage Accounts, and Azure Key Vault for secure secret/certificate management.
  • Support containerized application workloads by implementing, configuring, and maintaining Azure Container Apps (ACA) and Azure Container Registry (ACR).
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize robust Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines (multi-stage YAML) to automate validation (Bicep linting, what-if analysis), testing, and deployment of both infrastructure and application workloads.
  • Manage, curate, and contribute to internal module libraries using AVM standards, establishing best practices for parameterization, tagging, telemetry, and reusable cloud infrastructure components.
  • Implement DevSecOps practices across deployment pipelines, integrating secret management, RBAC, Managed Identities, and security scanning into CI/CD workflows.
  • Manage version control workflows, branching strategies, and release governance within Azure Repos / Git.
  • Configure and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics across network, compute, and container workloads.
  • Develop and enhance automation scripts using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Bash to streamline operational tasks and recurring environment management workflows.
  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including network topology diagrams, pipeline configurations, Bicep/AVM module guides, and runbooks.


#LI-SN1

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or Infrastructure Automation Engineer.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Azure Bicep, with demonstrated experience leveraging and implementing Azure Verified Modules (AVM).
  • Strong, proven experience with core Microsoft Azure Services:
    • Networking: Azure Virtual WAN (VWAN), Virtual Hub (VHUB), VNets, Subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Route Tables, and Private Endpoints.
    • Traffic & Security: Azure Application Gateway (App GW / WAF) and Azure Key Vault.
    • Compute & Containers: Azure Container Apps (ACA), Azure Virtual Machines (VMs), and ACR.
    • Storage: Azure Storage Accounts (Blob, File shares, Data Lake, Access tiers, and network access restrictions).
  • Strong proficiency in designing and implementing Azure DevOps Pipelines (multi-stage YAML pipelines, service connections, environments, approvals, and deployment gates).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Bash (Python is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including Azure RBAC, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Managed Identities.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization fundamentals (Docker) and deploying microservices to Azure Container Apps.
  • Experience with IaC validation and testing tools (Bicep linter, ARM what-if operations, PSRule).
  • Experience with monitoring, diagnostics, and telemetry using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Network Watcher.
  • Excellent documentation, analytical troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Relevant Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-104: Azure Administrator Associate, AZ-700: Azure Network Engineer Associate, or AZ-400: DevOps Engineer Expert) are an added advantage.

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Creators & Social Specialist


We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.


We are looking for a Senior Specialist, Creators to help build and activate Expedia Group's creator ecosystem and social-first programs in support of business and brand priorities. As part of the Social & Creators organization, this role works across the marketing organization to build trusted creator relationships and translate business and brand objectives into effective creator programs.


This role supports creator strategy, talent partnerships, campaign execution, creator-led storytelling, measurement, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, culturally curious, and passionate about using creators and social platforms to build authentic connections with audiences.


In this role, you will

Creator Partnership & Program Management

  • Own or co-own a portfolio of creator, ambassador, and talent partnerships across short-term, long-term, and always-on engagements
  • Build trusted relationships with creators, managers, agents, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Coordinate activity across teams and channels to improve creator experience, consistency, efficiency, and value

Campaign & Content Activation

  • Support end-to-end creator activations tied to brand priorities, product initiatives, launches, tentpole moments, cultural conversations, and business needs
  • Translate approved strategies into creator briefs, timelines, deliverables, and activation plans
  • Develop authentic creator-led storytelling that is native to the platform, audience, and format
  • Review concepts and content, manage feedback and approvals, and identify opportunities to extend, amplify, repurpose, and distribute content across channels
  • Stay informed on platform behaviors, cultural trends, and emerging formats to surface timely opportunities

Talent Discovery & Casting

  • Research and evaluate social-first creators across established and emerging platforms
  • Support casting recommendations based on audience relevance, performance, content quality, brand alignment, credibility, and brand safety
  • Identify emerging talent, partnership opportunities, and cultural signals that support evolving audience behaviors and business objectives

Commercial, Contracting & Rights Support

  • Support partnership scopes, rates, usage rights, exclusivity terms, extensions, amplification, and other commercial considerations
  • Help ensure partnership structures are cost-conscious, rights-ready, and capable of delivering value across campaigns and channels
  • Partner with Legal, Procurement, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to support compliant agreements, payment processes, and scopes of work

Measurement & Optimization

  • Track and interpret creator and campaign performance across reach, engagement, traffic, conversion, content utility, efficiency, and other key metrics
  • Translate platform, audience, and performance data into actionable recommendations for creators and internal stakeholders
  • Maintain scorecards, trackers, reporting systems, and documentation while contributing to business reviews, test-and-learn agendas, campaign recaps, and renewal decisions

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations

  • Partner closely with Organic Social while collaborating across Brand, Integrated Marketing, Paid Media, PR, Growth, Strategic Innovation, Product, Operations, Legal, Finance, and other teams
  • Gather stakeholder needs and convert inputs into actionable creator requirements while balancing competing priorities
  • Represent creator considerations in cross-functional planning and execution efforts
  • Manage timelines, briefs, trackers, budgets, invoices, approvals, asset storage, and program documentation
  • Build and improve scalable workflows, templates, playbooks, and operating practices
  • Leverage emerging AI tools where appropriate to improve research, briefing, reporting, and team efficiency
  • Support creator events, launches, activations, and related logistics as needed

Experience and qualifications

  • 4-7 years of experience in creator marketing, influencer marketing, social marketing, talent partnerships, integrated marketing, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience partnering closely with Organic Social teams and developing or activating social-first creator campaigns
  • Demonstrated experience managing creator or talent relationships and working with talent representatives, agencies, and cross-functional marketing teams
  • Experience supporting end-to-end campaigns, partnerships, content development, or marketing programs from planning through delivery
  • Strong understanding of creator ecosystems, social platforms, audience behaviors, cultural trends, and creator-led storytelling
  • Working knowledge of creator agreements, statements of work, usage rights, exclusivity, and paid amplification
  • Experience using reporting tools, performance data, trackers, and operational systems to improve campaign performance and efficiency
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities
  • Curiosity about emerging AI tools and their practical application to creator marketing workflows
  • Sound judgment related to authenticity, audience relevance, and brand safety
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

title: Senior Trust Administrator
description:
Senior Trust Administrator

Support the Administration of Sophisticated Fiduciary Relationships

At Wilmington Trust, we help individuals, families, family offices, and business owners preserve and transfer wealth across generations. As a Trust Administrator, you'll play an integral role in supporting the administration of complex trust relationships while delivering the exceptional service and attention to detail our clients expect.

Working alongside experienced Trust Officers, you'll help manage fiduciary relationships involving Delaware directed trusts, discretionary trusts, and entities holding closely held business interests and other unique assets. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your fiduciary expertise, build meaningful client relationships, and develop a long-term career in trust and wealth administration.



What You'll Do

  • Partner with Trust Officers to administer a portfolio of trust relationships, ensuring accounts are managed in accordance with governing documents, fiduciary standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, beneficiaries, attorneys, accountants, and other trusted advisors, delivering responsive and personalized service.
  • Support the administration of Delaware directed and discretionary trusts, including account maintenance, distributions, trust reviews, and documentation.
  • Assist with trusts holding closely held business interests and other complex assets.
  • Review and interpret trust agreements, wills, settlement agreements, modifications, and other fiduciary documents.
  • Coordinate client requests and collaborate with internal partners across investments, tax, legal, compliance, and operations to deliver seamless service.
  • Assist with new account onboarding, trust funding, beneficiary updates, fee arrangements, account coding, and account closures.
  • Monitor account activity and identify matters requiring escalation or additional review.
  • Maintain accurate account records and documentation while leveraging technology and operational resources to support efficient administration.
  • Prepare client materials, account reviews, and business presentations as needed.
  • Stay current on fiduciary regulations, trust and estate administration practices, and industry developments.

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong interest in fiduciary administration and wealth management.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to interact confidently with clients and advisors.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Sound judgment and understanding of fiduciary responsibilities.
  • Collaborative approach and willingness to partner across teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes.
  • Professionalism, integrity, and a client-first mindset.

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 2 years of experience supporting fiduciary account administration, trust administration, estate administration, or related financial services, legal, or wealth management experience.
  • In lieu of a degree, a combination of education and relevant experience, including at least 2 years supporting fiduciary or trust administration activities.
