title: Factory Controller
description:
We are seeking a Factory Contoller based in our Byhalia, MS factory to join the Finance Operations team. This role is fully onsite.


Ready to help build a better future for generations to come?


In an ever-changing, fast paced world, we owe it to ourselves and our future generations to live life responsibly. At ROCKWOOL, we work relentlessly to enrich modern living through our innovative stone wool solutions.

Join us and make a difference!


Your future team:

You will become part of the Finance Operations team and will be reporting to the Director - Operations Finance.

What you will be doing:

The Rockfon Operation Controller will be responsible for the analysis of the Rockfon (RFN) Factory Operations in the Byhalia. This position will be a key support resource for Operations and Finance Management.

  • Prepare financial data to initiate and support operating decisions and continuous improvement efforts. The Controller will be responsible for monthly, quarterly, and annual budgeting and reporting for the operations area including VPC, maintenance costs and fixed cost.
  • Generate Operations Reporting, conduct business analysis, reconciliation, and forecasts, and analyze actual results compared to budget and prior years for all factory and related activities.
  • Prepare annual standard costing and monitor actual versus standard deviation.
  • Monitor and control overall factory investment to align with group guidance, budget controlling, and project time controlling.
  • To provide back up and support for the MAR Factory Controllers in periods of absence
  • Provide ad hoc analysis support to the Operations and Finance team.

What you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA designation preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, with a strong understanding of manufacturing business processes.
  • Strong knowledge of general accounting and cost accounting principles.
  • Experience with standard costing systems, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a high level of ownership, commitment, and energy.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with sound business judgment and a practical, hands-on approach.
  • Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

What we offer:

  • Competitive Pay & Benefits from Day 1: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • 401K Match: Up to 6%
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO, 12 paid holidays, and parental leave.
  • Educational Assistance & Career Growth: Invest in your future.
  • Wellness Perks: Fitness reimbursement and EAP access.
  • Safety First: Company-provided PPE and programs to keep you protected.

The annual salary range for this role is $110,000 - $125,000. Your base salary is determined based on location, experience and the pay of employees in similar positions. This role is bonus eligible.

Who we are:

We are the world leader in stone wool solutions. Founded in 1937 in Denmark, we transform volcanic rock into safe, sustainable products that help people and communities thrive. We are a global company with 12,000 employees, located in 37 countries with 36 manufacturing facilities, all focused on one common purpose – to release the natural power of stone to enrich modern living. Sustainability is central to our business strategy. Through our partnership with One Ocean Foundation and in connection with our sponsorship of the Denmark SailGP team, we help raise awareness around ocean health challenges in an effort to accelerate solutions to protect it.


Work Environment & Conditions:

Our offices are designed to inspire collaboration, creativity, and meaningful social interactions., empowering employees to achieve balance and bring their best selves to work. ROCKWOOL is deeply committed to giving back to our communities. Through global philanthropic initiatives, community involvement, and sustainability efforts, we strive to create a positive impact in the communities we serve.

Our Culture and Commitment:

We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and heard. With employees representing 91 nationalities, we champion diversity, provide equal opportunities, and actively combat all forms of discrimination. At ROCKWOOL, you'll find a welcoming team environment built on what we proudly call “The ROCKWOOL Way”. This cultural foundation reflects our core values: ambition, responsibility, integrity and efficiency.


ROCKWOOL is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We assess all qualified candidates based solely on their skills and qualifications, without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, gender, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Program Manager
description:
Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Manager who will play a pivotal role in driving our fitness programs and creating a positive experience for our clients and members. This individual will lead and inspire a team of fitness professionals, delivering engaging health promotion and wellness programs that meet both immediate and long-term objectives. This is a hands-on management position, perfect for a leader passionate about fitness, client relationships, and results.

Responsibilities:

  • Hire, train, and supervise a team of qualified fitness professionals, ensuring staff deliver high-quality services to all participants.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate a variety of fitness, health promotion, and incentive programs tailored to client needs.

  • Align fitness programs with annual strategic planning to meet and exceed short- and long-term goals.

  • Manage the program budget, monitor expenses, and generate detailed reports on program performance and outcomes.

  • Build and maintain proactive relationships with client liaisons, ensuring client satisfaction and program alignment.

  • Perform initial fitness assessments, craft personalized exercise plans, and guide clients through their first workouts.

  • Offer fitness services to a diverse range of clients, including high-risk participants, with a focus on safety and individual needs.

  • Ensure the fitness center and exercise areas are supervised, safe, and compliant with health and safety guidelines.

  • Lead and manage the group exercise program, including scheduling and instruction.

  • Perform other tasks as required to support the department’s success and exceed client expectations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or a related field.

  • Current CPR/AED and First Aid certifications required.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a fitness environment, including hands-on training and client interaction.

  • Proven experience leading group exercise classes and tailoring workouts for various fitness levels.

  • Prior management experience in a fitness or wellness setting.

title: Senior HR Partner-(Onsite) Hebbal
description:
About the Role

At Netsmart, we are focused on transforming health and human services through technology, collaboration, and innovation. As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will play a critical role in helping leaders build, support, and empower teams that make a meaningful impact for the clients and communities we serve. This role translates business priorities into practical people strategies that support talent growth, organizational effectiveness, associate engagement, and change leadership.


Why Join Netsmart?

You will join a purpose-driven, collaborative team that lives our core values every day—working with purpose, taking accountability, showing respect, and bringing a solution-oriented mindset to challenges that matter. At Netsmart, these values shape how we attract, support, and grow talent across our global organization. This is an opportunity to partner with leaders, influence people strategy, and help create an associate experience where teams feel connected to the mission, empowered to do their best work, and inspired to grow their careers while contributing to work that makes a meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with leaders to build high-performing, inclusive teams through effective talent development, engagement, and retention practices.

  • Bring a hands-on, tactical approach to HR partnership, —able to execute and transact within Workday while also partnering with leaders to translate business needs into practical talent strategies, remove barriers, and help attract, engage, and retain the right talent to support growth.
  • Adapt and execute people programs to meet local business and market needs while supporting a consistent, values-driven associate experience.
  • Lead and support organizational change initiatives with clear communication, accountability, and a focus on adoption and measurable outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, with 8-10 years of experience partnering with leaders to drive talent, culture, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Experience working with Workday or a similar HR system to support HR processes, reporting, and associate data needs.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies and working effectively within a matrixed organizational structure.
  • Experience working in healthcare and/or IT environments is highly preferred.
  • Experience partnering with technology and product organizations to support talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, and a high-performance, people-first culture.
  • Ability to leverage AI, analytics, and data-driven insights to inform talent decisions, enhance associate experiences, and improve organizational outcomes.

  • Ability to operate with autonomy, sound judgment, discretion, and a proactive, accountable mindset.

title: Aircraft Inspector - 2nd Shift
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Inspects and determines airworthiness of aircraft, aircraft systems, equipment, and parts in compliance with specifications and applicable government regulations. Performs preflight and post flight inspections ensuring that all inspection forms are accurately completed. Works from approved drawings, FAA Regulations or other specifications.

JOB RESPONSIBLITIES

  • Carries out aircraft inspections, verifying and controlling specific documentation according to the inspection process.
  • Prepares reports on maintenance services and spare parts supplier performance such as: rejected/ non-compliance parts status, specified name, parts provided, quantities, discrepancies, technical performance, classifications, technical opinion, & recommendations.
  • Performs stock re-inspections.
  • Performs shipping inspections.
  • Monitors and verifies quality in accordance with control processes.
  • Ensures that all inspections are properly performed on all completed work in accordance with internal procedures and FAA requirements.
  • Files work orders and inspection forms in such a manner that the specific file pertaining to an assembly or unit can be located by the Chief Inspector promptly.
  • Conducts preliminary, hidden damage, inspection continuity, and final inspection on items repaired.
  • Performs review inspections on aircraft and components to monitor the quality of work performed and the adequacy of standards and equipment.
  • Performs occasional/random work package audits to ensure that documentation is maintained in accordance with Federal Aviation Regulations.
  • Performs “self-audits” of internal quality systems, and audits at the request of the customer.
  • Assists the Chief Inspector in analyzing and interpreting quality data in order to develop methods, procedures, and systems to improve the Quality Assurance functions.
  • Performs special assignments and projects, as directed by the Chief Inspector.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Education:

  • High School/ GED
  • Desired: A.S. degree in Aviation
  • A&P License

Experience:

  • Generally at least 5-7 years of experience as an aircraft A&P Mechanic.
  • Prior Inspector work experience with aerospace quality systems that meet FAA requirements.
  • Experience working with and interpreting, precision measurement instruments.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Assignments require Comprehensive Knowledge of all possible tasks and responsibilities within their Technical Area.
  • Skills are broadly applied in multiple Technical Areas.
  • Knowledge of machines and tools, including their uses, repairs and maintenance.
  • Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer service.
  • Skilled with repairing, troubleshooting, installing and equipment maintenance.
  • Knowledge of FAA requirements for aircraft maintenance procedures.
  • Ability to interpret and comprehend manufacturer and FAA approved work package instructions; ability to inspect and install parts/components.

Working Conditions / Environment/ Special Requirements

  • Ability to work in a safe professional manner adhering to all regulatory requirements including, OSHA, EPA, State and Federal regulations.
  • As required by the position, must have the ability to wear a respirator as per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134 "Respirator Protection" regulations with no restrictions that would prevent the proper use and/or seal of the respirator.
  • Ability to work flexible hours and different shifts if required.
  • Employees will be subject to the random drug and alcohol testing under FAA regulations.

GENERAL COMMITMENT FOR ALL EMPLOYEES

  • Commitment to company values and complies with department norms, policies, directives, and procedures.
  • Incorporates Lean and P3E processes and concepts into daily activities.
  • Strive for continuous improvement to processes and procedures.
  • Honors and protects confidential and proprietary documents and information.
  • Satisfies work schedule requirements.
  • The job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required by the employee. Performs other duties as assigned.

title: DevOps Engineer - CloudOps & FinOps
description:
Career Area:

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Who is CAT Digital? What do we do?

Big machines require big thinking. Are you looking for your next big challenge?

Cat® Digital is the digital and technology arm of Caterpillar Inc., leveraging the latest technologies to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers. With over one million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics, and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better world.

Working with a Fortune 100 leader, you can build your career on a global scale and take advantage of development opportunities with emerging technologies. We’ve created an inclusive environment for you to explore your passions, make an impact and do the work that really matters. Join Us.


Job Opportunity:

We are seeking talented individuals to join our team to help us establish and grow our presence, organization, culture, which will drive our digital product development efforts. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with top professionals working on very high impact and visibility products. Don't miss this chance to join and support digital innovation for a global leader in heavy machinery!

What will you do?

As a CloudOps & FinOps Engineer at Cat Digital's Slovakian branch, you will help operate, optimize, and govern Caterpillar's cloud environments while enabling engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and cost-efficient digital products.

You will:

  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure and shared services across AWS and Azure.
  • Drive cloud cost visibility, governance, and optimization through FinOps best practices.
  • Monitor cloud usage, performance, reliability, and security.
  • Develop and maintain automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and CI/CD solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and business teams to improve operational excellence and cloud efficiency.

This position works directly with Slovakia-based engineering leadership and Cat Digital IT teams in the US.

What you have:

  • Experience operating cloud environments in AWS and/or Azure.
  • Understanding of CloudOps, FinOps, cloud governance, and security best practices.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or similar).
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring, observability, and incident management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience working within an Agile environment.

Top Candidates will also have:

  • Experience with cloud cost management and FinOps tools.
  • Experience supporting multi-account AWS or multi-subscription Azure environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud security and governance platforms.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools.
  • Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of API platforms such as Apigee, AWS API Gateway, or Azure API Management.
  • AWS certification.

What we offer:

At Cat Digital, we are committed to fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning, and we believe in investing in the development of our employees. As a member of our team, you will have access to a wide range of training and development opportunities, as well as very competitive compensation and benefits packages, like:

  • Pension plan

title: Steward, Scotiabank Arena
description:
Powered by Passion. United by Purpose. Build for Impact.

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one.

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.

We bring these teams – and world-class entertainment – to life at our iconic venues, including Scotiabank Arena, BMO Field, Coca-Cola Coliseum, Ford Performance Centre, BMO Training Ground, and OVO Athletic Centre. Off the field, we serve up elevated dining at e11even, Real Sports, and our signature club spaces like Hot Stove Club, ScotiaClub, and Platinum Club.

Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.

This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves.

So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team.

description:
Whether you’re a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Why Rosendin?

Committed. Innovative. Engaged.

If you’re looking to take career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. We are the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED company in the industry which means you will be a company owner too and have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.

YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:

The Senior Estimator is responsible for preparing and completing bid/submittal documents and cost estimates for electrical construction projects. The Senior Estimator is the Lead Estimator for projects and works with other Estimators, suppliers, and customers to complete the estimate.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Prepare estimate from quantity take-off on project and complete estimate to computer printout.

Job Description:

Supervisor de Envasado

¿Por qué unirse a nosotros?

Prepárate para liderar un área clave en la operación de nuestra planta como Supervisor de Envasado, asegurando el cumplimiento de volúmenes de producción, tiempos establecidos y estándares de seguridad y calidad.

En esta posición tendrás la oportunidad de dirigir equipos de trabajo numerosos, coordinar el funcionamiento de equipos industriales y participar en iniciativas de mejora continua que impactan directamente en la eficiencia de nuestras líneas de envasado.


Lo que harás

Reportando al Jefe de Envasado, serás responsable de coordinar y supervisar las actividades de envasado, asegurando el cumplimiento de volúmenes, tiempos de producción y estándares de seguridad, calidad y disciplina operativa.


Tus principales responsabilidades serán:


· Supervisar el proceso de envasado garantizando volúmenes y tiempos de producción.

· Controlar el funcionamiento de equipos como envasadoras, paletizadores, etiquetadoras y sistemas de pesaje.

· Liderar equipos de aproximadamente 25 colaboradores por turno (operadores, líderes de envasado y montacarguistas).

· Asignar tareas y asegurar el cumplimiento de procedimientos operativos.

· Garantizar disciplina operativa, orden y limpieza en planta (housekeeping).

· Detectar fallas operativas y coordinar con mantenimiento intervenciones correctivas y preventivas.

· Gestionar pedidos e inventarios mensuales de consumibles.

· Participar en procesos de optimización de las líneas de envasado.

A quién buscamos

Buscamos una persona con liderazgo, capacidad de influencia y orientación a resultados, capaz de gestionar equipos grandes y mantener altos estándares de seguridad y calidad.


Requisitos:

· Título de tercer nivel en Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Automatización, Ingeniería Mecatrónica o carreras afines.

· Experiencia supervisando equipos operativos de al menos 10 personas.

· Experiencia en procesos productivos o industriales.

· Conocimientos básicos en mecánica, electricidad y automatización industrial.

· Manejo de Microsoft Office y deseable experiencia en sistemas de gestión (Power BI).


Lo que recibirás

Como parte de Nutreco, formarás parte de la familia SHV, un grupo global y diverso de empresas que ofrece amplias oportunidades profesionales. Tendrás acceso a experiencia internacional y trayectorias profesionales, respaldadas por la estabilidad y el enfoque a largo plazo de una de las empresas privadas más grandes del mundo

Además, recibirás:


  • Seguro médico privado.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Alimentación.
  • Más beneficios.


Cómo y por qué saber más

Podemos ofrecerte una carrera con verdadero significado y propósito, donde te sentirás orgulloso de lo que haces cada día y del papel que desempeñas en Alimentar el Futuro. Si te interesa unirte a nosotros, prepárate para asumir tu desarrollo, tu potencial y tu carrera. Nuestro objetivo es revisar todas las solicitudes en un plazo de cinco días laborables y nos pondremos en contacto contigo lo antes posible.

title: Senior EDI Data Analyst
description:
Senior EDI Data Analyst

Job Description

Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you, innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

About the Role

Provide EDI business and configuration support for K-C North America for both the Consumer and KCP sales organizations. Collaborate with other analysts to monitor and troubleshoot EDI transactions, providing a reliable exchange of electronic information between K-C and the customer. Drive continuous improvement for EDI processes and error reduction to enable touchless order flow.

Successful EDI Sr Data Analysts have solid analysis skills, great communication (both written and verbal), work well in a highly collaborative environment, and manage/balance multiple projects to meet expected service levels with attention to detail.

In This Role, You Will

  • Troubleshoot EDI transactions by monitoring electronic queues to quickly resolve inbound and outbound transmission errors and respond to e-mails and phone calls. Prioritize and expedite assistance based upon severity of situations.

  • Analyze customer requirements to determine EDI configuration needs and system specifications. Create entries in system tables and map data between internal applications and standardized EDI formats to support.

  • Apply industry rules and guidelines to ensure compliance.

  • Manage system and tool security access based on role definitions.

  • Generate, monitor, and report out EDI key performance indicators and scorecards to reveal issues and highlight system enhancement opportunities. Include actions taken to address red conditions.

  • Establish continuous improvement targets and apply LEAN problem-solving techniques to improve system and process efficiencies and First Time Quality for EDI.

  • Develop and maintain standard work documents for EDI processes, mapping specifications, and partner configurations.

About You

You perform at the highest level possible, and you appreciate a performance culture fueled by authentic caring. You want to be part of a company actively dedicated to sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development.

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or other relevant field.

  • At least 4-10 years of experience in EDI or related IT roles.

  • Base understanding of SAP functionality in Order Management, Distribution, Material Master and Customer Master pertaining to EDI outputs, IDOCs, and Partner Profiles.

  • Experience with Open Text third party provider's solution and/or other EDI mapping tools.

  • Proven systems aptitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in EDI transactions (e.g. 850, 875, 846, 855, 856, 860, 865, 870, 880, 810, 864, 824).

  • Knowledge of programming languages such as C++, Java, SQL, XML, CSV, and VB.Net.

  • Experience with a broad mix of technologies, IT infrastructure, and order processing.

  • Proficient in data access tools and PC-based applications (Windows, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Reporting Tools).

  • Analytical and troubleshooting skills to assess system issues, debug errors, and optimize processes.

  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in both oral and written communication to build relationships and collaborate with business teams.

  • Attention to detail and responsiveness to quickly resolve issues is a must.

  • Continuous improvement mindset to drive right first time and efficiencies.

  • Results and strategy oriented, project and risk management, and change management.

Led by Purpose. Driven by You.

We believe that our employees are our greatest asset, and we're committed to providing them with the resources they need to be successful. If you're looking for a rewarding career with a company that cares about its employees, then Kimberly-Clark is the place for you.

To Be Considered

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.

And finally, the fine print….

For Kimberly-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers. When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. description:

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our ever-evolving DevOps team and help shape the future of global commerce. In this role, you’ll strengthen the cloud platforms, automation and delivery capabilities that help our technology teams move faster, operate reliably and scale with confidence. Your work will directly improve engineering efficiency, platform resilience and the speed at which Global Payments delivers secure, dependable technology to support our clients and the future of payments.

What you’ll own

  • Drive faster, more reliable software delivery by advancing automation across build, release and deployment processes, reducing manual effort and strengthening delivery consistency.

  • Own production readiness and recovery capabilities by strengthening deployment practices, troubleshooting complex cloud issues and ensuring disaster recovery processes are tested, understood and ready when they matter most.

  • Lead through technical influence and collaboration by providing technical direction to DevOps engineers, partnering with project management, business sponsors and senior leaders, and helping the team make informed decisions that deliver stronger business outcomes.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of experience in information technology, with demonstrated success designing, delivering or supporting complex technology solutions, plus a bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong cloud and Kubernetes expertise, with experience provisioning, managing and troubleshooting infrastructure and applications across platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.

  • An automation-first and continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, simplify delivery processes and create scalable solutions that improve reliability, performance and engineering effectiveness.

It's a bonus if you have

  • Software development or scripting experience using technologies such as Java, Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy or Ruby, along with experience integrating systems using JSON, REST or XML.

Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

**_Job Code: 44821_**

**_Job Location:_** **_Clifton, NJ_**

**_Job Schedule:_** **_9/80- Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours working- and have every other Friday off_**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a Systems Integration & Test Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead with comprehensive knowledge in Electronic Warfare systems and a solid understanding of project management. This role is responsible for leading a multi-disciplinary team in the integration and test of system hardware, software, and supporting facilities, ensuring electrical and physical compatibility while meeting program technical, schedule, and cost objectives.

The IPT Lead will support system design and development efforts from early design through integration, test, installation, and customer acceptance. This individual will work closely with Program Management, Chief Systems Engineering, and customers to plan and execute system-level integration, verification, and test activities.

**Essential Functions:**

- Lead integration and test efforts for complex Electronic Warfare systems across the full program lifecycle.
- Manage cross-functional teams with minimal oversight to achieve program technical, cost, and schedule objectives.
- Develop and maintain system-level integration and test strategies, plans, and top-level test flows.
- Coordinate with Systems Engineering to develop verification approaches and requirements verification matrices.
- Ensure physical and electrical compatibility of system components and interfaces.
- Support development of test procedures, test configurations, and special test equipment/software needed for verification.
- Lead or support test readiness reviews, test working groups, anomaly investigations, and program status reviews.
- Troubleshoot test failures and drive resolution in collaboration with systems, design, and test teams.
- Identify and manage integration and test risks, opportunities, and mitigation plans.
- Work with design and systems teams to incorporate testability early in the development lifecycle.
- Interface directly with program management, Chief Systems Engineering, customers, and subject matter experts regarding integration and verification planning.
- Ensure compliance with L3Harris policies, processes, and quality standards.
- Ability to obtain a US security clearance

**Responsibilities**

- Serve as the primary lead for top-level integration and test planning and execution.
- Develop the System Integration & Test Plan for the program.
- Support planning and execution of test events, including test readiness activities and follow-up actions.
- Define or support definition of Special Test Equipment (STE) / Ground Support Equipment (GSE) requirements needed for system verification.
- Oversee implementation and checkout of test equipment, software, and analysis tools.
- Support test execution planning, including coordination of personnel and shift coverage as needed.
- Provide technical leadership and mentoring across the team.


**Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 6 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Direct experience serving as an IPT Lead for integration, test, or development programs.
- Experience supporting flight test, environmental qualification, and customer verification activities.
- Familiarity with discrepancy reporting, root cause investigation, and corrective action processes.
- Experience supporting both development and production environments.
- Familiarity with systems engineering, requirements management, and configuration management tools.
- Experience presenting technical status, risks, and issue resolution plans to customers and senior leadership.
- Experience managing subcontractor technical performance and coordination.
- Experience with risk management and cost account management.
- Familiarity with LabVIEW, MATLAB, Boundary Scan, or similar test automation and instrument control tools.
- Familiarity with military environmental and electromagnetic qualification standards, including MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-461.
- Knowledge of OSHA requirements and ESD control best practices.
- Familiarity with RF and high-speed digital test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, power meters, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.

  - 5+ years of experience in Electronic Warfare (EW), avionics, aerospace and defense systems, or related mission systems.
  - 5+ years of experience in system integration, verification, and test across multiple phases of the system lifecycle.
  - 3+ years of experience leading or coordinating cross-functional technical efforts.
  - 3+ years of experience in electronic hardware troubleshooting, manufacturing support, and root cause analysis.
  - 4+ years of experience in radio frequency (RF) and/or digital engineering, including experience with any of the following:
    - Microcircuit Assembly (MCA)
    - Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)
    - Circuit Card Assembly (CCA)
    - Printed Wiring Board (PWB)
  - 2+ years of experience supporting verification or qualification to military and/or civil standards such as:
    - Environmental Conditions and Test Procedures for Airborne Equipment (DO-160)
    - Software Considerations in Airborne Systems and Equipment Certification (DO-178C)
    - or similar standards
  - 3+ years of experience supporting DoD or U.S. Government customers.
  - Demonstrate ability to communicate effectively through technical documentation, status reporting, and cross-functional coordination

title: Electrical PCBA Sustaining Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


Perform hands-on diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of complex electronics at the PCB and board level to support KLA products throughout their lifecycle. This role requires strong technical capability in PCBA failure analysis, the ability to work through circuit-level problems with limited design documentation, and close collaboration with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver timely, high-quality repair solutions


Key Responsibilities:


  • Diagnose and troubleshoot defective PCBAs using oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and related lab equipment
  • Conduct PCBA design analysis (reverse engineering) to understand circuit intent and failure modes, building toward reverse engineering capability
  • Troubleshoot PCBA issues with limited or no design documentation, applying critical thinking and systematic debugging techniques
  • Perform board-level failure analysis on analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits, working with senior engineers when issues span sub-system boundaries
  • Support the development of board diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair plans — including contributing to approach definition, timeline estimation, and identification of technical dependencies
  • Support engineering change orders (ECOs) with technical justification and cross-functional coordination
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective action implementation, with increasing independence on moderate-complexity problems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (systems, software, manufacturing, service, supply chain) to support issue resolution
  • Support technical engagement with external vendors on issue resolution and repair readiness
  • Develop and maintain engineering documentation including test procedures, troubleshooting guides, and repair records.
  • Engage with suppliers to train them on board troubleshooting, repair execution trainings
  • Communicate progress, findings, and risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Work effectively with junior and senior team members in a collaborative environment
  • Travel for escalations as needed, primarily to Singapore and China

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline
  • 7+ years of experience in electronics develop, sustaining engineering, or board‑level sub‑system support
  • Demonstrated ability to independently resolve complex board and sub‑system level issues
  • Strong expertise in analog and digital circuit design principles and hands‑on PCBA troubleshooting
  • Proven experience driving root‑cause analysis, corrective actions, and ECO execution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross‑functional teams

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's Level Degree and 3 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5years; or equivalent work experience

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

About us


With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate, and innovate to build brands consumers love. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new insights, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.

The purpose of this role is to ensure that the markets’ tax processes (including VAT, customs & excise duty, environmental taxes and other supplementary returns) are undertaken accurately, efficiently (utilising automation) and on time and the surrounding internal control procedures, legislative requirements are closely adhered to.

The role will support the successful implementation and ongoing operation of the Global Tax processes, controls and automation tools under the new Tax Operating model.


Scope of role covers preparing VAT, customs & excise duty, environmental tax and connected returns. This requires interaction with the Tax Senior, a number of functions including both markets and central functions with a special focus on financial controlling teams and Source to Pay and Sell to Cash teams.


About you


What you will be responsible for:

  • Preparing VAT, customs & excise duty, environmental taxes and connected supplementary returns in accordance with global standard process and controls, utilising automation tools where applicable
  • Working closely with tax seniors to ensure compliance with market specific regulatory requirements and legislative changes
  • Supporting routine VAT, customs & excise duty, environmental taxes and other tax related audit enquiries and projects for your markets under the supervisory of the Tax Lead (Team leader).
  • Working closely with Tax Senior to ensure compliance with market specific regulatory requirements and legislative changes
  • Preparing balance sheet reconciliations and ensuring these are done on time and in an internal and external control compliant way.
  • Actively handling tax document retention for your markets.
  • Supplying to the continuous improvement- through establishing a LEAN approach to drive effectiveness and efficiency- of the tax compliance processes
  • Embedding and operating the new controls and KPI reports, supervising the implanted KPI-s, investigating root-cause or errors and working with end-to-end processes to improve KPIs
  • Ensure Tax Calendar is supervised and filled-in in a timely and quality manner
  • Promptly responding to market queries in respect of markets in their responsibility and supporting direct tax leaders, business partners, SME-s in non-routine questions, projects, and during tax audits in their competency.

What you'll bring

  • Qualified graduate economist with at least 1 year post qualification finance experience (internship counts as well)

  • Experience in working with SAP is an advantage
  • Strong analytical and questioning skills

System Integration and Platform Validation

· Ensure validation coverage, entry and exit criteria, defect management, and readiness supported by evidence to deliver to program milestones and product quality objectives.

· Drive timely issue identification, prioritization, root-cause determination, and closure across partners, original design manufacturers, and internal teams.

· Champion engineering and operational excellence by establishing metrics and processes for regular assessment, learning, and improvement.

People and Organizational Leadership

· Provide direct and ongoing leadership for a team of system validation engineers, other individual contributors and external partners.

· Manage staffing and talent responsibilities including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, coaching, career development, and succession readiness.

· Establish clear objectives, accountability, and development plans that support strong execution and continued growth of team capability. Manage team’s budget and project planning.

· Build an engineering culture emphasizing collaboration, disciplined execution, technical learning, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

· Ensure effective communication and collaboration between team members, global development teams, and outsourced resources. Lead key supplier’s on performance delivery and coordinate corrective action of services not meeting expectations.

· Lead process improvements to increase validation effectiveness, optimize resources, and reduce costs in alignment with business goals.

Program and Cross-Functional Leadership

· Manage deliverables, schedules, costs, and resource allocation across ongoing projects; identify and mitigate execution, quality, and schedule risks.

· Ensure validation goals, timelines, and budgets align with program and organizational roadmaps; recommend realignment when business or program conditions change.

· Represent the system validation perspective in program leadership forums and provide clear readiness assessments and recommendations for milestone and Go/No-Go decisions.

· Communicate status, risks, and escalations to direct management, program leaders, and internal and external development partners.

· Partner with Architecture, Hardware, Software, Security, Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory, and Field Engineering teams to assess technical and schedule risk.

· Support customer escalations and field issues within the system validation scope, coordinating cross-functional investigation and resolution.

· Lead recurring and ad hoc functional reviews with cross-functional and global stakeholder groups.

Education and Experience

· Typically 5-10 years of job-related experience, including relevant experience in electronics or computer development, hardware and materials testing, system integration, product validation, or a related technical development environment. Direct experience working in lab and test environments and knowledge of engineering and scientific test equipment.

· Typically 0-7 years of management or technical leadership experience, including leadership of engineering functions, teams, and delivery across organizational or geographic boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Program Manager- Waiver Case Management
description:
Program Manager- Waiver Case Management
Company Overview:
At Residential Transitions, Inc. (RTI), our mission is to help people improve their quality of life by empowering them with knowledge, resources, and skills—while always treating them with dignity and respect. We proudly serve individuals across Minnesota who are living with mental illness, substance use challenges, and other disabilities. Our services support people living independently in the community, in their own homes, as well as in our residential settings. Through compassionate care and a person-centered approach, we aim to make a lasting difference in the lives of those we serve.

Position Overview:

Program Manager- Waiver Case Management provides person-centered case management services to individuals diagnosed with serious and persistent mental illness, substance use disorders and co-occurring medical conditions who are eligible to receive services through the Community Access for Disability Inclusion (CADI) or Brain Injury (BI) Waiver Case Management services. The Program Manager will train, advise, and consult with other Waiver & Dual Case Management employees.

Role Responsibilities:
  • Lead, supervise, and develop the team to support business needs through engagement, motivation, and retention.
  • Manage and maintain a caseload of individuals who are diagnosed with serious and persistent mental illness, substance use disorders and co-occurring medical conditions throughout Dakota county
  • Visit clients at least once a month and twice annually in accordance with waiver-specific rules.
  • Coordinate client intake and discharges, within set parameters and timelines.
  • Collaborate with other professionals such as physicians, mental health providers, and other teams as needed to develop and update plans for each client.
  • Ensure financial authorizations and provider contracts are in place
  • Ensure services are documented in individual records so information is readily available, results of services can be determined, and record-keeping standards are met.
  • Access available community and housing resources so that necessary and relevant resources match an individual’s needs and preferences.
  • Provide crisis assessment and intervention so individuals receive the assistance they need to be safe in their home and community.
Required Qualification and Experience:
  • Must meet any of the three qualifications:
    • Be a graduate from an accredited four-year college with a major in social work, psychology, sociology or a closely related field.
    • Be a graduate from an accredited four-year college with a major in any field and 2000 hours of experience as a social worker/case manager/care coordinator in a public or private social service agency.
    • A public health or registered nurse providing case management must be licensed under Minn. Stat. §148.171-§148.285.
  • At least two(2) years of management experience.
  • A background in Waivered Case Management.
  • Knowledge of community resources and how to access them.
  • Willingness to travel within the Metro Area, for applicable mileage reimbursements, with a current driver’s license, clean record, and personal vehicle with insurance; and able to transport clients in that vehicle.

  • At least one(1) year of direct supervisory experience in Waivered Case Management.
  • Knowledge of Procentive software.
  • Experience with third-party billing and an electronic health record system.

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Professional Growth: CEU courses, clinical supervision, and monthly paid trainings relevant to services provided.
  • Career Advancement Opportunities: Grow within RTI.
Compensation: $55,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year
Type: Full-Time
Location: Hennepin/Dakota County

Employees in this role must be able to:

  • Walk, stand, sit, bend, climb stairs, and perform crisis prevention/intervention techniques
  • Use hands for writing, typing, data entry
  • Lift up to 40 lbs. and occasionally exert physical effort during duties
  • Maintain vision and hearing necessary for reading charts, operating office equipment, using a computer, and driving a vehicle

title: Principal Game Designer | New Games
description:
Craft:

Job Description:

Principal Game Designer (Puzzle Core)

Help craft the moment to moment magic of a new King Game

Join our New Games Studio and help build the next generation of King experiences. We’re developing a new casual puzzle game and we’re looking for a Principal Game Designer to help shape the feel, challenge, and moment to moment fun of the game.

In this role, you will design and evolve the core puzzle gameplay, including level mechanics, blockers, moment to moment interaction systems, and overall difficulty progression that define the player experience.

Working closely project Leadership, you will help craft gameplay that is deeply satisfying, approachable, and scalable across thousands of levels, ensuring that the game delivers both delightful player experiences and strong long term engagement.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom

As a Principal Game Designer, you will play a key role in defining and refining the core gameplay systems of the game, helping ensure the puzzle experience remains engaging, readable, and satisfying for players across the entire progression journey.

You will work closely with other designers, artists, engineers, and product partners to bring gameplay features to life and ensure they align with both the creative vision and the broader game strategy.

You will:

  • Design and iterate on the core puzzle gameplay, ensuring the moment-to-moment interaction feels satisfying, responsive, and accessible.

  • Create and evolve blockers and level mechanics, developing gameplay elements that introduce challenge, variety, and strategic depth.

  • Help define the overall gameplay feel, including pacing, readability, clarity, and player feedback.

  • Collaborate with design leadership team to ensure blockers and mechanics integrate well into the wider level progression.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Data Scientists to analyse player behaviour and tune gameplay difficulty, progression, and engagement.

  • Prototype and develop new gameplay mechanics, exploring ideas that enhance the puzzle experience and expand the game’s design space.

  • Ensure gameplay systems align with the game’s broader meta and economy systems, working with systems and economy designers when necessary.

  • Maintain high standards of design quality, balancing creative ambition with technical constraints and production realities.

  • Document and clearly communicate gameplay designs, ensuring teams across disciplines understand design goals and player outcomes.

  • Identify and communicate design risks early, working closely with producers and engineers to ensure smooth delivery.

  • Stay connected to the market, analysing puzzle and casual games to identify emerging trends and opportunities.

  • Contribute to the studio’s design craft community, sharing learnings and supporting the growth of fellow designers.

Skills to Create Thrills

  • Experience working on mobile games, particularly free to play titles.

  • Strong passion for casual mobile games and meta game design.

  • Proven experience designing meta systems, progression frameworks, or long term engagement mechanics in successful games.

  • Strong understanding of player motivation, progression design, and long term engagement loops.

  • Experience designing systems that connect gameplay with progression, rewards, and feature unlocks.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret player behaviour and data insights to guide iteration.

  • Experience collaborating within multidisciplinary teams, balancing creative, technical, and product perspectives.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to drive features from concept through delivery.

  • Clear and effective communicator verbally, visually, and in written documentation.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving development environments where systems evolve through iteration.

  • Experience working on Sorting / Match Pair / Match 3D mechanics is especially valuable.

Game Experience

We’re looking for someone with a strong background in creating video games and a passion for designing compelling casual meta experiences. Mobile development comes with unique opportunities and constraints, requiring a balance of creativity, insight, and technical awareness. We want someone who embraces those challenges with enthusiasm and a desire to craft experiences that will delight millions of players around the world.

We’re Seriously Playful

Officially, we’re a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world. Unofficially, we’re a serious business that takes pride in having fun. Every day at King, we blend intuition with analysis, art with science, and imagination with execution to craft games the world loves to play.

Our mission is simple: bring moments of magic to everyday life. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

A great saga needs all sorts of heroes

Making games is fun. Especially when you do it with people who share the same idea of what makes a good workplace great.

We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life.

Truth is, we simply can’t expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Performs other work duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning tasks logically related to the position.

title: Product Developer - Upholstery
description:
Are you innovative, focused, and love to create new things? Is quality a priority for you? Are you always looking for better ways of doing things? If you said yes to all these questions, then we think you might be a good fit as a Product Developer at Kaas Tailored.
Here at Kaas Tailored, we value relationships. Whether it be with our customers, vendors, or employees, we are looking for individuals who can partner with us in our goal to put people first and create quality products. As a Product Developer, you would be part of a team that is responsible for designing new furniture and aerospace products and finding creative and innovative solutions to customer needs. Individuals in this position enjoy working in both the digital and physical world. Product Developers who thrive in this position are organized, quick learners, persistent, and love to work with their hands.
*Learning Opportunities - We are all about growing people! Want to learn carpentry skills, how to use a variety of tools and equipment, and other technical hands-on skills? - Kaas is the place for you!
Essential Job Duties:
  • Upholstery and Soft Goods Fabrication:
    • Apply hands-on upholstery skills to construct, fit, and refine furniture prototypes.
    • Work with fabrics, foams, and other soft good materials to meet design intent, comfort, and durability standards established from our customer.
    • Troubleshoot fit and construction issues during prototyping, adjusting patterns and techniques as needed.
    • Build production ready products that translate design concepts into upholstered pieces that our production team can make repeatedly.
    • Develop Bill of Materials (BOMs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for continued manufacturing.
  • Product Design and Development:
    • Alongside our cross-functional product development team, lead the design and development of new products from initial concept through to production.
    • Collaborate with cross functional teams including Account Management, Purchasing, and Production to ensure product designs meet customer needs and company goals.
    • Utilize CAD software to create detailed product designs and specifications.
  • Collaboration with Customers and Industrial Design:
    • Work alongside industrial designers to ensure that product designs are manufacturable and meet technical specifications.
    • Meet directly with customers throughout the development process to understand requirements, preferences, and use cases.
    • Present prototypes and upholstered samples to customers for feedback, and incorporate that feedback into revised iterations.
    • Provide input during the design phase on fit, materials, and constructability.
    • Build and maintain customer relationships that support repeat collaboration on future product development.
  • Physical Requirements:
    • Able to lift 50 lbs. frequently.

Ideally, qualified applicants have:

- Bachelor’s degree or 3-5 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Furniture Product Development/Upholstery, a related field, or matching relevant experience.
- Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, NX, Fusion360).
- Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and production methods.
- Experience developing or optimizing manufacturing processes and production workflows is a benefit for this role.
- Familiarity with commercial aerospace requirements, commercial furniture requirements, feasibility studies and continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
- Continuous learner mentality.
- Fabrication experience utilizing hand tools; CNC machinery and general woodshop experience is a plus.
- Familiarity with process documentation such as work instructions and standard operating procedures (preferred, not required).
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Company Background:
Kaas Tailored is a growing, world-class manufacturing company located in Mukilteo, WA and for the last 50 years, we have built high-quality furnishings for airplanes, homes, and commercial environments. In an effort to love our employees better, we do things a little differently by training our teams in the use of lean principles and by providing the tools and skills necessary to improve their work and remove burden from processes. We also have the pleasure of sharing these principles and tools with companies from around the world who come to our shop to learn our way of thinking, see our processes, and hear from our great people how small changes can make a big difference in daily work.

Starting wage is $30.50 - $41.65 per hour depending on experience.
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Under 12 months: 1 hour PTO for every 30 worked.

Holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas are paid for 10 hours after 1 month of employment.

Tuition Assistance: Eligible after 6 months of employment.

title: Emergency Vehicle Technician
description:
Position Type:

Permanent

*

Closing date:

*

Emergency Medical Care Inc. (EMC) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Medavie Health Services (MHS) that manages and operates ground ambulance, air medical transport and the medical communications operations in Nova Scotia through a performance-based contract with the provincial government's Emergency Health Services (EHS) Operations division and the Department of Health and Wellness. As well, EMC operates TeleHealth/811 medical communications for Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island for the Department of Health.

We access all communities in Nova Scotia in a timely and efficient manner with our fleet of more than 180 ambulances and support vehicles operating out of 60+ stations. We respond to 165,000+ calls annually across the province, which are actively managed through the EHS Operations Medical Communications Centre, the hub of all emergency (911) and non-emergency (hospital transfers) medical calls.

The EHS Operations LifeFlight program provides even greater accessibility by responding to patients on scene or through inter-facility transports by our critical care team via helicopter, fixed wing, or ground ambulance.

In addition, paramedics in Nova Scotia participate in various programs both urban and rural such as community-based paramedic programs, collaborative emergency centres, and emergency preparedness and special operations, to name a few.

There are lots of opportunities waiting for you in Nova Scotia. Apply now to learn more about our service and available positions.

*

Reporting to the Manager of Fleet Services, the Emergency Vehicle Technician (EVT) is a key part of a team that provides a well maintained, safe, effective and efficient fleet of vehicles designed to give optimal customer service and patient care.


Each EVT is accountable to exercise “highest standards of cleanliness available” in the industry. The Technicians are expected to conduct themselves in a safe and prudent manner. The Technicians will be largely responsible to ensure all ambulances are safe, effective, and preventatively maintained in accordance with policies and procedures as stated by EMC and EHSNS.


As an employee of EMC, we are accountable to our patients and coworkers by participating in and supporting all safety related initiatives, as well as acting in a manner that fosters a culture that focuses on patient safety and a safe workplace.

Duties and Responsibilities:


The position entails, but is not limited to the following:

  • Operates all vehicles in accordance with all policies of EMC and EHS.
  • Obtains (EVT) Emergency Vehicle Technician Certification
  • Completes all Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) certifications as directed.
  • Acquires all company and self-directed education learning as it relates to the EVT’s core work and responsibilities.
  • Maintains a valid motor Vehicle Inspection license in keeping with the type and style of vehicle managed by EMC
  • Maintains and ensures proper documentation on all work orders including ODOM readings, all parts allocated to work order quantity, part numbers, detailed description for what services and repairs were conducted and all allocated labor times applied to the repair. All inspection sheets to be populated and end-of-day status report to be submitted to Fleet Manager and Team Lead (s).
  • Compiles a list of any mechanical parts, supplies or tools required to be ordered on a daily basis.
  • Completes all mechanical repairs as directed.
  • Conducts reasonable ongoing cleanliness of station during scheduled shift.
  • Practices excellent customer service skills interacting with vendors, colleagues, paramedics and any member of the general public.
  • Performs other such similar, comparable or related duties as may be required or assigned. Offsite Operational Base Generators services and repairs.
  • Must be willing to travel to other fleet centers for operational coverage when required.
  • Must be productive and produce a higher standard of quality of work.
  • Takes instruction and direction operationally from the Manager, Fleet Services or alternate.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:


Education/Experience:


  • Excellent practical working and knowledge of the Motor Vehicle Repair Trade, workload management, basic computer programs and inventory control.
  • Five (5) years’ experience as a Red Seal Certified Automotive Service Technician. Completion of SDS, Emergency Vehicle Repair, and any other course centered on understanding Ambulance manufacturing, repair, and inventory control.
  • Valid Nova Scotia Class 4 Driver’s License in good standing
  • Possesses and retains a current Nova Scotia Motor Vehicle Technician Red Seal Certification in good standing
  • Willing to acquire and maintain a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Certification.

Knowledge & Skills:


  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Must possess good interpersonal skills in dealing with people and working in groups.
  • Displays good decision-making skills and takes initiative as needed.
  • Has the ability to work alone with minimal supervision.
  • Exercises a degree of discretion and independent judgment.

Physical Requirements:


Potential exposures to contaminated items. Irregular work schedules, work environment possibly shift work and overtime as needed. Service centers can be cluttered, greasy, and dirty at times.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Turn Business Problems into Smart Data & Technology Solutions

Are you the person who naturally asks,"Why are we doing it this way?" and then finds a better solution?

At Merkle, we're looking for a Business Systems Analyst who can bridge the gap between business strategy and technical delivery. In this role, you'll work directly with clients and cross-functional teams to uncover business needs, define solutions, and help bring innovative data, marketing technology, and AI-driven initiatives to life.

This is not a role where you simply document requirements and move on. You'll be a trusted advisor, collaborator, and problem solver, helping clients navigate complex challenges while partnering with architects, engineers, and business leaders to drive meaningful outcomes.

What You'll Do

Partner with Clients

  • Lead discovery workshops and requirements sessions that uncover business needs and drive decisions.
  • Ask thoughtful questions, identify gaps, and help stakeholders clarify their goals.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable requirements, use cases, and solution recommendations.
  • Contribute to pre-sales conversations and solution design discussions.

Connect Business and Technology

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Create requirements documentation, process flows, user stories, and solution summaries.
  • Help clients understand how data, technology, and AI can support their goals.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities and perspectives.

Drive Solution Delivery

  • Own workstreams and collaborate closely with engineers, architects, and project teams.
  • Manage priorities, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
  • Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing, and user acceptance activities.
  • Identify risks early and help teams navigate challenges before they impact delivery.

Embrace AI and Innovation

  • Use AI tools to improve requirements gathering, documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Explore new technologies and recommend smarter ways of working.
  • Stay current on trends across customer data, marketing technology, analytics, and AI platforms.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You might be a strong fit if you:

  • Have experience in business analysis, consulting, solutions delivery, product, or technology-focused roles.
  • Enjoy working directly with clients and facilitating conversations that drive outcomes.
  • Can comfortably communicate with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Have experience with platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
  • Understand data flows, integrations, customer data, and marketing technology ecosystems.
  • Are organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
  • Regularly use AI tools to improve how you work and solve problems.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients leave meetings with clear decisions, next steps, and confidence in the path forward.
  • Delivery teams receive complete, actionable requirements that help them move quickly.
  • Business stakeholders understand the value and impact of technology solutions.
  • Projects stay organized, focused, and on track.
  • You continually introduce new ideas, efficiencies, and innovations that improve outcomes.

Why Merkle?

At Merkle, you'll work with leading brands to solve challenging business problems at the intersection of data, marketing technology, customer experience, and AI. You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple industries, collaborate with talented experts, and help shape the future of customer engagement and digital transformation.

If you're curious, consultative, technically minded, and passionate about helping businesses solve complex challenges, we'd love to meet you.

About Arden University:

We are an aspirational and multi-award-winning university, delivering rapid growth with ambitious plans to disrupt the HE sector through our passion for innovation and digital education. Our vision is to become the first-choice university for career-focused lifelong learners worldwide, ensuring that everyone, everywhere can access higher education.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines, forge worldwide partnerships, and expand our locations.

About our Department:

The Academic Office at Arden University plays an important role in supporting academic governance, quality assurance, and student success. The department oversees key processes such as programme validation and approval, policy development, regulatory compliance, and assessment management.

Working closely with faculties, professional services, and external regulatory bodies, the Academic Office ensures that Arden’s academic standards align with sector benchmarks and accreditation requirements. It is also responsible for enhancing student experience by maintaining fair and transparent academic policies, supporting assessment boards, and facilitating effective learning and teaching practices

About the Opportunity:

We are seeking an exceptional and forward-thinking Director of Academic Excellence to lead and shape the future of teaching, learning and academic practice across Arden University. This is a high-profile leadership role with responsibility for defining what excellent academic practice looks like and ensuring our academic community has the frameworks, capability and support needed to deliver outstanding student experiences across all modes of study.

Working closely with senior academic leaders, Deans and specialist Directors, you will use evidence and insight to identify opportunities for enhancement and drive institution-wide improvements in teaching quality, academic development and educational innovation. You will lead the Academic Excellence function, creating scalable approaches that strengthen academic capability, promote inclusive and engaging learning experiences, and deliver measurable impact for students.

This role offers the opportunity to influence academic strategy at the highest level while translating vision into practical, evidence-led interventions that improve teaching practice, student outcomes and academic performance. You will also play a key role in embedding innovation, including the effective use of AI in education, supporting curriculum and assessment enhancement, and fostering a culture where excellent teaching is recognised, shared and continuously developed.

About You:

You will be an experienced academic leader with a strong track record of improving teaching quality, learning and academic practice within a higher education environment. You will bring significant expertise in educational enhancement and the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across a complex organisation.

You will have a deep understanding of contemporary pedagogy, curriculum design, assessment, academic development and the UK higher education sector. Equally important is your ability to use data, insight and evidence to identify priorities, develop targeted interventions and demonstrate meaningful impact.

To succeed in this role, you will combine strategic thinking with a practical, delivery-focused approach. You will be comfortable challenging established practices, leading change and building high-performing teams, while maintaining strong relationships with colleagues across faculties, campuses and professional services.

A doctorate or equivalent professional standing is essential, alongside substantial senior leadership experience in higher education. Experience of leading large-scale teaching and learning initiatives, academic development programmes or educational enhancement frameworks will be key, while knowledge of digital pedagogy, AI-enabled learning or technology-enhanced education would be advantageous.

Why Arden:

At Arden, you will become a part of a passionate and dedicated team who are committed to removing unnecessary barriers to learning and making education more accessible. Our people work hard to ensure our students journeys are the best they can possibly be, as such we want to reward our people with fantastic benefits. Employees benefit from:

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines and locations.

title: Lab Pack Chemist
description:
Job Description

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Handles hazardous materials including inventorying, identifying, segregating, and packaging waste material in accordance with Lab Pack policies, procedures and practices and all applicable regulations.

Qualifications:
Basic Requirements:
  • An associate’s degree in general science (BS preferred) is required for the Lab Pack Chemist.
  • Driver’s License with clear record.
  • Moderate to extensive travel with 20% overnight travel.
