title: Engineer - Spatial Analytics
description:
Overview

As a Spatial Analytics Engineer, you will bridge spatial data, spatial analysis, engineering, and business intelligence to develop scalable spatial solutions that put the right data in the right place, in the right format, at the right time. Under limited supervision, you will develop and maintain spatial data and features, perform advanced spatial analyses, create reports and visualizations, and develop insights and recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making across the agency. This position has a wide and deep scope requiring extensive knowledge and skill across spatial analysis, the Esri platform, spatial data management, and related data and reporting technologies.

This position is responsible for delivering reliable spatial data, analysis, and solutions for internal and external customers of Community Transit. The successful candidate will bring strong hands-on experience applying Esri and spatial analysis to complex business questions, while also having the ability to develop and maintain the data, workflows, and reporting products that support that work. The role requires someone who is interested in using spatial information to understand patterns, solve problems, communicate insights, and improve decision-making across the agency.

Essential Duties

Spatial Data Engineering

  • Develop and maintain spatial features.
  • Design, implement, and maintain data processing workflows within the data warehouse.
  • Create transformations, define dependencies, and ensure efficient, reliable execution across the pipeline.
  • Develop and optimize data models that transform and prepare data for high performance and alignment with business use cases.
  • Establish monitoring, testing, and validation practices, including automated data quality checks, to proactively detect and resolve errors.

Enterprise Reporting & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with departments across the agency to design and deliver curated spatial features and actionable reports and dashboards that translate business requirements into data solutions.
  • Develop and publish interactive dashboards and story maps in ESRI, including creating compelling visualizations (heat maps, charts, graphs, dashboards) tailored to stakeholder needs.
  • Prepare, validate, and analyze data to ensure accuracy and derive insights that inform strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Explore complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights, communicating findings in a clear and business-focused manner.
  • Apply statistical and analytical techniques with tools such as SQL, Python, Arcade, and R to interpret data trends and generate meaningful recommendations.

Data Governance

  • Enforce enterprise-wide standards for data consistency, integrity, and accuracy across all platforms and business domains.
  • Adhere to governance frameworks for version control, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure work is in alignment with organizational architecture and compliance standards.
  • Continuously monitor and validate reporting products, ensuring long-term fitness for business use.
  • Document processes, codebases, data lineage, and reporting logic.
  • Discover, document and, manage data access policies that follow security, business, and regulatory requirements.

Influence

  • Enable, support, and encourage the use of data in decision-making.
  • Integrate with teams across the enterprise to understand subject matter and improve data maturity and culture change.
  • Perform other duties of a similar nature or level.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Three years of experience managing and querying data in a relational database environment (Snowflake, SQL Server, Oracle etc.).
  • Three years of experience in data analysis using advanced tools (R, Python etc.).
  • Two years of experience in spatial data creation and analysis in ESRI software.
  • Two years of experience modeling data in Star Schema.
  • Bachelor’s degree computer science, Geography, GIS, or a similar field.

An equivalent combination of education and experience to successfully perform the job duties is also accepted.

Knowledge Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of assigned department’s work program and data sources.
  • Sufficient knowledge of two other departments work programs and data sources to provide review and backup assistance as needed.
  • Basic understanding of DevOps processes.

Skill Requirements

  • Fostering an inclusive workplace by upholding Community Transit’s core values in support of the organization’s vision and mission. Inspiring team commitment, pride, and trust while promoting cooperation and motivating members to achieve shared goals. Demonstrating courtesy, sensitivity, and respect in all interactions.
  • Ability to frame business questions into data analysis problems and develop solutions.
  • Proficient in data manipulation (data validation, window or custom functions, pivot/unpivot) and analysis using Excel, SQL, Arcade, and Python/R.
  • Strong proficiency with the Esri ArcGIS platform, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Portal, ArcGIS Online, web services, geoprocessing, spatial analysis, and web GIS.
  • Data cleaning, validation, and review techniques.
  • Intermediate statistical skills for more complex data analysis (regression, clustering, hypothesis testing).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking abilities.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision.
  • Ability to write technical documentation for standard processes.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical information to various audiences through reports and presentations.
  • Willingness to stay updated with the latest developments in the field of spatial data analysis and engineering, and to continue learning and improving skills.
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills for handling multiple tasks and projects.
  • Team player: encouraging, communicative, supporting, contributing, and enthusiastic.

Certain knowledge and skill requirements may be learned or further developed after employment begins.

Preferred Skills and Knowledge

  • Experience with Snowflake or other cloud-based enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience developing automated spatial workflows using Python and SQL.
  • Developing advanced ArcGIS expressions and application logic using Arcade.
  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS REST services, APIs, and web GIS application development.
  • Experience integrating GIS with data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, APIs, or other enterprise systems.
  • Experience with source control and development workflows such as Git, DevOps, or CI/CD practices.
  • Knowledge of spatial database design, data modeling, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience developing data validation, monitoring, testing, and automated quality control processes.
  • Experience with transportation, transit, public-sector, or other location-based operational data.
  • Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI or equivalent reporting and visualization tools.

Working Conditions

Hybrid telework may be available. Availability is at management discretion and may not be available for this position based on the nature of the work. Work is performed in an office environment and requires the use of office equipment and technology. You will be required to move throughout and between different office buildings and may need to complete tasks in noisy environments. You may also be required to lift and carry materials up to 10 pounds occasionally. Some travel required, less than 10% of the time.

Application and Selection Process

title: Project Manager - Device Lifecycle Management
description:
Project Manager - Device Lifecycle Management

Purpose of the role

This role provides day-to-day ownership of the business-as-usual device lifecycle management service, taking on the activities previously carried by Central Project Manager. The focus is operational delivery rather than programme design: holding to account for service performance, keeping internal functions moving on their commitments, running the governance rhythm, and giving senior stakeholders a clear and consistent picture of where the service stands. The post holder works closely with Contracts, Procurement, Finance and Legal, and is expected to be credible in front of Client senior leadership.

Key accountabilities

Supplier relationship and performance

• Own the day-to-day operational relationship with Client and act as the single point of contact for escalation on non-delivery, stock shortages and processes that are not working.
• Drive root-cause resolution of delivery misses and depot or logistics failures, and hold to agreed recovery plans and dates rather than repeated status updates.
• Monitor service performance against contracted SLAs and KPIs, challenging reported data where it does not reflect the experience of users in the business.
• Manage formal contractual correspondence as it arises, including relief event and delay notices, working with Contracts, Legal and Procurement so that Client's position is documented and defended.

Accountability and issue management

• Maintain a single consolidated issue and action log, with named owners, due dates, current status and a clear escalation path.
• Hold Procurement, Finance, Legal and Contracts accountable for delivering their committed actions to time, escalating early and factually where commitments slip.
• Drive items to closure rather than simply reporting on them, and surface aged or at-risk actions to the Service Line lead.
• Keep a live risk register with mitigations, owners and defined triggers for escalation.

Governance

• Own and execute the BAU governance model end to end, including operational calls, monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews and the executive steering forum.
• Run each forum properly: calendar, agenda, pack issued in advance, attendance, minutes, decisions recorded and actions tracked through to closure.
• Ensure the right decisions are taken at the right level, so that executive time is used for decisions rather than status reporting.
• Keep governance artefacts current as the operating model evolves, including terms of reference, RACI and the escalation matrix.

Narrative and stakeholder management

• Translate operational detail into a clear narrative for stakeholders: what is happening, what it means for the business, and what is needed from them.
• Produce the regular reporting rhythm, including weekly and monthly updates, executive summaries and decision papers, to a standard that can go straight to senior leadership.
• Operate confidently with the Client senior leadership team: able to present, be challenged, hold a position and commit to actions in the room.
• Manage messaging to the business groups, business units and countries affected by device supply issues, setting expectations proactively rather than reacting to complaints.

Data, reporting and financial control

• Own the recurring reporting on device demand, stock position and delivery performance, and make sure the numbers are trusted as one version of the truth.
• Track cost impacts, invoicing and billing disputes and budget implications with Finance, and provide the evidence base for any commercial discussion with the supplier.
• Maintain visibility of the forward stock position against demand peaks, and keep contingency options open where supply is at risk.
• Ensure asset data, security and device disposal obligations are met across the full lifecycle.

Continuous improvement and transition

• Identify recurring process failures and drive permanent fixes into the operating model instead of accepting repeated workarounds.
• Coordinate communications to end users and IT support teams whenever process or supply changes land.
• Take a full handover of context, contacts and open commitments so that no thread is dropped in transition.

Experience and skills

• Proven experience as a BAU service or project manager in an outsourced or managed service environment, with direct supplier management responsibility.
• Commercially literate and comfortable working with contract schedules, service levels and service credits alongside Contracts and Procurement colleagues.
• Resilient and assertive, able to hold a large supplier and internal functions to account without damaging working relationships.
• Strong written communication, capable of producing executive grade papers and updates with minimal rework.
• Highly organised and detail driven, comfortable operating with ambiguity, competing priorities and a global stakeholder base across time zones.

title: DWS - Solution Architect (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description:

Employer: DWS Group

Title: Solution Architect (m/f/d)

Location: Frankfurt

About DWS:

At DWS, we’re capturing the opportunities of tomorrow. You can be part of a leading, client-committed, global Asset Manager, making an impact on individuals, communities, and the world.

Join us on our journey, and you can shape our transformation by working side by side with industry thought-leaders and gaining new and diverse perspectives. You can share ideas and be yourself, whilst driving innovative and sustainable solutions that influence markets and behaviours for the better.

Every day brings the opportunity to discover a new now, and here at DWS, you’ll be supported as you overcome challenges and reach your ambitions. This is your chance to lead an extraordinary career and invest in your future.

Read more about DWS and who we are here.

Team / division overview

The Chief Technology Office (CTO) within the DWS COO division is responsible for shaping and delivering the firm's technology strategy, transformation agenda and innovation priorities. Working across business and technology functions, the CTO Office enables the delivery of scalable, secure and efficient technology solutions that support DWS's strategic objectives, operational effectiveness and long-term growth.

The Solution & Data Architecture team shape the architecture standards, patterns, and guidance that enable delivery teams to build scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions. They work closely with Domain Architects, Security specialists, Data SMEs, platform teams, and delivery squads to ensure that solutions are aligned with DWS strategy, architecture principles, and policy requirements.

The team supports delivery from early requirements shaping through to solution design, design governance, and implementation support. This includes defining data ingestion, transformation, and consumption approaches, designing application and service architectures, and contributing reusable patterns, decision trees, and architecture decision records. The team also explores emerging technologies and develop practical guidance to continuously improve the DWS technology landscape.

Your responsibilities

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into solution designs, building blocks, services, data pipelines, integrations, and user-facing components.

  • Own and drive end-to-end solution design, ensuring alignment with DWS architecture principles, technology strategy, security requirements, and design governance.

  • Work closely with data architects to define effective approaches for data ingestion, transformation, management, and consumption.

  • Guide and coach engineering teams during implementation to ensure designs are understood, practical, and delivered as intended.

  • Collaborate with Domain Architects and fellow Solution and Data Architects to create architecture decision records, reusable patterns, and practical guidance for recurring design challenges.

  • Support delivery teams in presenting and defending solution designs through relevant architecture and design authorities.

  • Evaluate, prototype, and assess new technologies, deriving practical usage patterns that help modernize and continuously improve the DWS technology estate.

We are looking for:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Typically 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a comparable technology role.

  • Strong understanding of modern application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, integration patterns, and cloud-native design principles.

  • Experience in designing and building or integrating with ABAC or RBAC controls or systems (IAM)

  • Strong Java experience, including the Java ecosystem, Spring Boot, J2EE/Jakarta EE, and modern JDKs.

  • Ability to break down complex problems into clear, actionable, and implementable solution components.

  • Experience working with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and architecture or governance forums.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience in financial services, asset management, or another regulated environment.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience with .NET, TypeScript, Python, or modern front-end and service development approaches.

  • Understanding of data architecture, data pipelines, data governance, and data consumption patterns.

  • Experience with TOGAF, SAFe, or comparable architecture and delivery frameworks.

  • Experience defining reusable architecture patterns, decision trees, architecture decision records, and design standards.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with the ability to assess their practical relevance for enterprise adoption.

  • Confident conversational and professional proficiency (B2)—you can comfortably negotiate, present, and collaborate with German-speaking clients.

  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Posting Period: 08.09.2026 until further notice

What we’ll offer you:

Without the ambitions of our people, our achievements wouldn’t be possible. And it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.

Some of our core benefits:

  • Physical and Mental Health Well-Being benefits including (but not limited to) Statutory Health Insurance (BKK), sickness benefit allowance and support helplines for employees

  • Family friendly benefits including generous parental leave packages (supporting all variations of family set-ups) and support in finding childcare options including DWS’s own kindergarten service

  • A wide selection of pension plans, Personal Budget Accounts to enable sabbaticals or early retirement and capital-forming benefits

  • The opportunity to support our CSR strategy which is focused on combatting climate change & achieving greater social justice. You can make donations to our partnered organisations or take part in corporate volunteering opportunities in your local communities by providing on hand support.

DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.

If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let us know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.

We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this #ConnectingTheDots.

title: Operador de Montacargas II
description:
The Forklift Operator is responsible for receiving, storing and transporting of raw materials, packaging materials, supplies and finished goods, so that these be taken in storage in the prescribed manner and are available in time for production or shipping. He / she may also perform stock count and stock control activities, supporting adequate inventory and stock management.
The position of Forklift Operator is located in a warehouse of an OpCo. The department is responsible for receipt, storage, transportation and dispensing of raw materials, packaging materials, supplies, finished products and waste materials.
He / she operates a manually controlled, rider-type powered truck with forks or other lifting devices (e.g., clamps, barrel lifters, customized devices) to transport materials of all kinds around a warehouse or plant. The materials to be moved, the location, and destination are clearly indicated. The Forklift Operator may perform routine equipment servicing, such as attaching a battery chargers, replenishing fuel, and checking for safety of equipment and operations.

Job Description:

· Receiving, handling and control of raw materials and goods supplied, so that it is determined whether deliveries are in accordance with the purchase order and

shipping documents, and are in good condition.

To do this primarily, the Forklift Operator:

o Checking receipts on appearance and on the basis of lading and packing slip, reporting defects to supervisor

o Marking lading, and record of receipt and quality data in the system.

· Storage

o Stores of raw materials, packaging materials, finished goods and pallets by a forklift truck so that they are placed in the prescribed storage locations, and the

requirements in terms of safety are met.

o conducts inventory counts, periodically comparing actual stock with the administrative inventory, detection and reporting of deviations

· Transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, supplies, finished products and waste materials to and from the production departments on the basis of

production planning, at the request of production management and at its own discretion, so that the production may have the right goods on time, and stagnation

by of product accumulation can be prevented.

· Operational support / Operator activities

o May perform various manual operational activities and/or operates basic machinery / tools

o May performs basic checks and controls on materials, like checking weights, size, visual checks etc. Signals deviations with supervisor

· Other activities as required, such as:

o Performs user maintenance on rolling stock

o Performs other duties as required

· Good housekeeping / Compliance

o Keeps the rolling stock and other equipment, the work place and environment clean and tidy;

o Cleans all equipment and work environment

o Performs all activities in compliance with the relevant HSE and quality standards, both internal Nutreco standards as well as external standards.

· Communication

o Reports defects, deviations and other non-compliance issues to the supervisor

o Discusses work with colleagues and supervisor

o Provides information when asked, follows-up instructions and guidance from colleagues and supervisor

· Compliance

o Works in compliance with all applicable SHEQ (Safety, Health, Environmental and Quality) requirements and regulations, as well as with operational and

legal requirements safety regulations and procedures, as well as technical standards

o Signals potential hazardous and / or unsafe situations, takes appropriate action is case of imminent unsafe situations

title: Paraeducator (RLC) SPED - 3 hours
description:
REDWOOD CITY SCHOOL DISTRICT

CLASS TITLE: PARAEDUCATOR SPECIAL EDUCATION

RCSD takes pride in our dedicated workforce and strong connection with our students, families, and community. Our highly dedicated and skilled team of professionals provides a safe and supportive, inspirational and rigorous, joyful and inclusive environment for all learners. We are looking to build our workforce with a staff who share this vision and want to instill passion in learning emphasizing student strengths and gifts for all learners: all abilities, all ethnicities and cultural identities, LGBTQ+ youth, and multilingual learners.

BASIC FUNCTION:

Under the direction of an assigned supervisor, perform a variety of instructional tasks in support of a special education classroom of students with emotional, educational, physical and/or behavioral problems; assist the teacher by performing a variety of clerical duties related to special education programs; assist in monitoring and responding to students with special needs.

REPRESENTATIVE DUTIES:

Assist in the instruction of students with emotional, educational, physical and/or behavioral problems; maintain sensitivity to learning difficulties encountered by students with special needs.

Assist a certificated teacher by providing individual assistance to students in academic areas; work with small groups of students to reinforce instruction provided by the teacher.

Assist in the review of student history and in the review of individual education plans as directed; review daily lesson plan with instructional personnel.

Assist in the development and presentation of learning materials and instructional exercises; assist in compliance with established timelines and activities related to the master plan.

Assist students with activities for the development of small muscles and eye-hand coordination and deficiencies; lead activities designed to help students achieve motor control and body awareness.

Observe behavior of students to assure safety; assist in resolving student disputes; assist in the development and management of appropriate student behavior using positive reinforcement techniques.

Set up work areas and prepare areas for reading, crafts and other activities; set up exhibits, displays, collections and bulletin boards.

Order and operate a variety of instructional and audio-visual equipment as required; operate copiers, computers, typewriter and general office machines as needed.

Maintain routine records related to student work and classroom activities; grade tests and check student test corrections; maintain confidentially of student records according to established policies and guidelines.

Assist in performing clerical tasks such as typing, duplicating, filing and taking attendance; distribute and account for an inventory of textbooks, supplies and equipment.

Accompany mainstreamed students to regular classrooms as assigned; provide individual instructional assistance.

Monitor children on the playground, on educational field trips and during lunch time; monitor students getting on and off school buses as assigned; assist in planning and arranging field trips and special activities and transport children on field trips as assigned.

Confer with teachers concerning programs and materials to meet students’ needs as necessary; administer and score classroom tests as assigned.

Attend staff meetings and in-service programs as required; attend meetings related to curriculum or student issues as needed.

Translate oral and written communications between teacher, child, parents and district personnel as needed.

Perform first aid in emergency situations according to established guidelines; observe health and safety rules and procedures.

Perform related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE OF:

General needs and behavior of children.

Basic subjects taught in district schools including math, reading, writing, grammar, and spelling.

Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation and vocabulary.

Correct oral and written usage of English and a designated second language as required.

title: Online Programmer USSDK
description:
#### Company Description

Ubisoft is a world leader in the video game industry, with teams around the world creating original and memorable experiences, from Assassin’s Creed and Rainbow Six to Just Dance and much more. We believe that diverse perspectives allow both players and teams to thrive. If you are passionate about innovation and pushing the boundaries of entertainment, join us and help create the unknown!

#### Job Description

As an Online Programmer at Ubi Montréal, supporting production teams, you will shape the connected experience for players gathering online. The systems, features, and services you design, develop, optimize, deploy, and maintain will serve to offer them an unparalleled multiplayer environment.

With each new iteration, you will commit to answering the most fundamental questions: Will players connect efficiently? Can the servers support hundreds of thousands of people? Is the connected experience fluid?

Equipped with state-of-the-art tools, your reliable and cohesive team will use inventiveness, logic, and mutual support at every stage of development to always answer "yes" to these questions and thus accomplish its mission: to offer the best possible online gaming experience, that is to say, the one our players deserve.

**What you will do**

- Develop high-performance, reliable, and above all, fun online systems in collaboration with gameplay and game design teams.


- Understand existing functions and suggest improvements in order to create the best possible online experience.


- Collaborate with several production and production support teams with the goal of achieving a common vision.


- Fix bugs related to online systems and ensure their maintenance.


- Document your work to make the various features clear.


- Stay up to date with technology to ensure the studio is always at the forefront of online services.


#### Qualifications

**What you will bring to the team**

- A degree in computer science or software engineering (or other relevant training)


- Experience in the development and optimization of online systems written in C++, C#, GO, Java, and Python


- Experience in online systems and services and in online code optimization


- Knowledge of connected feature design with Playstation Network or Xbox Live (an asset)


- Knowledge of cloud systems such as Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, etc.


- Interpersonal and collaboration skills allowing you to realize the game's vision harmoniously with the various teams


- A keen sense of rigor and autonomy, accompanied by a great thirst for learning


- A creative spirit focused on innovation

title: Regional Director of Operations
description:
At California Pizza Kitchen, we bring the biggest and best parts of ourselves to work and to our communities, and are guided by our ROCK philosophy (Respect, Opportunity, Communication, and Kindness). We are committed to moving people forward and encourage everyone to apply their passion at CPK. So go ahead…be bold, be epic, be YOU!


SUMMARY OF POSITION

Regional Partners (RPs) are instrumental to the success of all CPK restaurant operations. As a Regional Partner, you will have a direct impact on the success, hospitality, and growth of CPK within your region. You will serve as the extension of the Restaurant Support Center (RSC) in the field and will oversee and manage the operations, hospitality standards, and performance of multiple restaurants within a designated region. You will be responsible for ensuring the profitability, growth, guest experience, and overall success of the restaurants under your jurisdiction.


OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

  • Act as the principal steward of CPK's standards across the region, ensuring every restaurant consistently delivers on the brand promise for both guests and employees. Lead by example and reinforce expectations through coaching, recognition, and accountability, ensuring excellence in food quality, hospitality, cleanliness, food safety, leadership effectiveness, and overall restaurant execution.
  • Serve as a trusted coach, partner, and thought leader to General Managers, strengthening their ability to lead teams, make sound business decisions, develop future leaders, and deliver sustained restaurant performance.
  • Recruit, coach, develop, and retain restaurant leaders through performance management, succession planning, and ongoing leadership development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence throughout the region by establishing clear expectations, providing ongoing feedback, recognizing and celebrating success, and holding leaders accountable for results.
  • Champion and uphold CPK's culture and ROCK philosophy by ensuring it is consistently demonstrated in leadership behaviors, team member interactions, decision-making, and guest experiences, creating an environment where the culture is visible, authentic, and thriving in every restaurant.
  • Ensure restaurants effectively execute against established sales forecasts by validating labor schedules, staffing deployment, food preparation plans, inventory levels, and operational readiness. Hold leaders accountable for aligning resources with projected business volumes to maximize productivity, control costs, and deliver a consistently strong guest experience.
  • Create and maintain a disciplined field leadership cadence that prioritizes meaningful time in restaurants coaching management teams before, during, and after key business periods. Partner with leaders to assess shift readiness, identify opportunities in real time, and develop consistent operating routines that strengthen execution, elevate team performance, and drive sustainable business results.
  • Ensure restaurants are maintained in a safe, functional, and brand-appropriate condition by providing oversight of facilities, repairs and maintenance, equipment performance, and capital asset needs across the region. Partner with restaurant leaders and vendors to drive preventive maintenance programs, prioritize facility investments, manage repair expenditures, and address issues proactively to minimize operational disruptions, protect team member and guest safety, and preserve the CPK brand experience.
  • Monitor guest feedback, complaint trends, and guest recovery efforts while partnering with restaurant leadership to improve guest satisfaction and protect the CPK brand.
  • Partner closely with the People Business Partner on employee relations matters, including investigations, performance management, corrective action, leadership coaching, and compliance with company policies and employment laws.
  • Collaborate with People, Recruitment, and Training to support staffing, talent development, leadership readiness, administrative processes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Build effective partnerships with RSC departments, vendors, and business partners to successfully execute company initiatives and support restaurant operations.
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, regulatory requirements, licensing obligations, and applicable federal, state, and local laws, including labor and employment regulations related to wage and hour practices, meal and rest periods, workplace safety, employee relations, and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Provide senior leadership with clear and timely communication regarding business performance, operational priorities, emerging risks, and strategic recommendations while effectively leading the resolution of operational, guest, employee, or business-related issues across the region.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Minimum of four (4) years of progressive multi-unit restaurant operations leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of restaurant operations, hospitality, food safety, labor management, and operational best practices.
  • Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost controls, profit optimization, and analysis of key business metrics.
  • Proven ability to lead, develop, coach, and hold leaders accountable for performance and results.
  • Ability to think strategically, solve complex problems, and make sound business decisions that drive operational performance.
  • Knowledge of talent management, employee relations, and leadership development practices.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships and effectively influence leaders across all levels of the organization.
  • Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple initiatives, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams).

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to travel to various locations, locally and nationwide, up to 60% depending on the geographical location.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Prolonged periods of computer and office work.
  • Ability to work in a restaurant environment with exposure to varying noise levels and temperatures.
  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, including up to twelve (12) hours per day.
  • Ability to occasionally bend, stoop, kneel, reach, lift, carry, and move up to forty (40) pounds.
  • Ability to perform the physical demands of restaurant operations, including navigating kitchen and dining room environments.
  • Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WHO IS CALIFORNIA PIZZA KITCHEN

We are passionate individuals committed to inspiring others by bringing California creativity to every meal! Founded in 1985, former federal prosecutors Rick Rosenfield and Larry Flax combined their fervor for food and fresh ingredients to create innovative, hearth-baked pizzas such as The Original BBQ Chicken, California Club and Thai Chicken that are created in a lively open kitchen. The concept gave California a place in the pizza revolution alongside Chicago and New York. CPK has since become the place for taste makers, rule breakers and earth shakers who conquer challenges by daring to work on the edge and thinking creatively.


THE PERKS

  • Tremendously passionate, one-of-a-kind company culture.
  • Opportunities for growth and development. We love promoting from within!
  • Unique electronic learning platform appropriately titled “The Proof” to engage continuous development.
  • All the pizza you can eat!
  • An environment where you can express your unique talents and skills.
  • Employee driven assistance program called the Kindness Fund which lends a helping hand to our team members encountering life challenges.
  • Industry competitive compensation package including bonus potential.
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and more.

NOTE: This job description is not a contract of employment. The job duties and requirements may be changed at any time, with or without notice, at the discretion of the employer to ensure the continued success of the business.


The current salary pay range for this role is: $120,000 - $135,000.


Various benefits are available for this position, including 401K, health, dental, vision, and disability insurance through CPK’s designated providers. CPK regularly reviews its benefits offerings and may change benefits and providers from time to time.


California Pizza Kitchen is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, or any other legally protected classification. Everyone has a seat at our table.

title: RPA Customer Engagement Specialist
description:
The Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Team requires one full-time Customer Engagement Specialist to support the expansion and adoption of automation capabilities across the Defense Health Agency (DHA), Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs), and other supported organizations.

The position will serve as a primary outreach resource for the RPA Team, proactively identifying opportunities where automation can reduce administrative burden, improve operational efficiency, increase accuracy and compliance, and return valuable time to the DHA workforce.

The successful candidate will combine customer engagement, process discovery, marketing, and communication skills with an understanding of automation and digital transformation. The position will work closely with government program leadership, RPA developers, business analysts, and prospective customers to develop and maintain a sustainable pipeline of automation opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement and Pipeline Growth:

  • Proactively identify and pursue new RPA opportunities across DHA, MTFs, program offices, and other supported organizations.
  • Develop and execute outreach strategies designed to increase awareness and adoption of RPA capabilities.
  • Establish relationships with organizational leaders, business process owners, and other key stakeholders to identify automation needs.
  • Conduct targeted outreach to organizations with manual, repetitive, high-volume, and rules-based business processes.
  • Maintain a pipeline of prospective automation opportunities from initial engagement through formal RPA intake.
  • Track customer engagements, potential opportunities, follow-up actions, and conversion of prospective opportunities into RPA projects.
  • Identify opportunities to expand successful automation use cases to other DHA organizations performing similar business processes.

Customer Engagement and Process Discovery:

  • Meet with prospective customers to understand existing business processes, pain points, workload challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Conduct initial process-discovery discussions to determine whether a business process may be an appropriate candidate for RPA.
  • Assist customers in understanding RPA capabilities, limitations, requirements, and expected benefits.
  • Coordinate with the RPA technical team to evaluate prospective opportunities for feasibility and potential business value.
  • Guide interested customers toward the appropriate RPA intake and service-request processes.
  • Maintain regular communication with prospective and existing customers throughout the engagement process.

Marketing and RPA Awareness:

  • Develop and execute an RPA marketing and awareness strategy across DHA.
  • Promote RPA capabilities through briefings, demonstrations, webinars, roadshows, leadership engagements, MTF outreach, conferences, and other communication channels.
  • Develop customer-facing marketing materials, presentations, success stories, capability briefs, one-pagers, and other RPA promotional content.
  • Coordinate live demonstrations of existing automations to illustrate the practical application and value of RPA.
  • Develop compelling RPA use cases highlighting measurable outcomes such as labor-hour savings, reduced errors, improved compliance, increased data quality, and faster processing.
  • Support and maintain content for the DHA RPA website and other approved communication platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to increase visibility of RPA successes throughout DHA.

Stakeholder Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between prospective customers and the RPA Team during the early stages of automation discovery.
  • Develop productive relationships with MTF leadership, administrative organizations, program offices, functional communities, and other DHA stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customer meetings, RPA capability briefings, demonstrations, and follow-up engagements.
  • Maintain awareness of organizational priorities and emerging business challenges that may present opportunities for automation.
  • Encourage cross-organizational sharing and reuse of successful automation concepts where appropriate.

Metrics and Reporting:

  • Develop and maintain customer-engagement metrics.
  • Track outreach activities, customer engagements, automation leads, intake submissions, qualified opportunities, and projects entering the RPA development pipeline.
  • Monitor the progression of prospective opportunities from initial contact through intake and development.
  • Assist in documenting projected and realized benefits, including labor-hour savings, cost avoidance, processing-time reductions, and quality improvements.
  • Provide recurring pipeline status reports to RPA program leadership.
  • Use customer feedback and engagement data to recommend improvements to outreach and service-delivery strategies.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must Hold Secret Clearance and maintain ability to hold Secret Clearance
  • Experience in customer engagement, account management, marketing, program support, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain professional relationships with customers and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience developing and delivering presentations, capability briefings, demonstrations, and customer-facing materials.
  • Ability to identify customer business challenges and translate those challenges into potential technology or process-improvement opportunities.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple prospective opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical team members.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting DHA, DoD, MTFs, federal healthcare, or other federal organizations.
  • Experience with Robotic Process Automation, intelligent automation, workflow automation, digital transformation, or business process improvement.
  • Familiarity with UiPath or comparable automation platforms.
  • Experience with customer relationship management, opportunity tracking, or pipeline-management processes.
  • Experience supporting technology demonstrations, conferences, roadshows, or organizational outreach campaigns.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Power Platform, or similar collaboration and workflow technologies.
  • Experience conducting business process discovery or assessing processes for automation potential.

Desired Knowledge and Competencies:

The candidate should understand how to identify processes that are strong candidates for automation, particularly those that are:

  • Manual and repetitive
  • Rules-based and standardized
  • High-volume or time-consuming
  • Prone to human error or rework
  • Dependent on data entry or transfer between systems
  • Associated with significant administrative burden
  • Capable of producing measurable operational benefits through automation

Key Performance Indicators:

Success for this position may be measured through:

  • Number of DHA and MTF organizations engaged
  • Number of RPA capability briefings and demonstrations conducted
  • Number of new automation opportunities identified
  • Number of qualified opportunities progressing to formal intake
  • Growth and health of the RPA project pipeline
  • Percentage of leads converted into viable automation projects
  • Expansion or reuse of successful automations across multiple organizations
  • Estimated labor hours and operational efficiencies associated with opportunities generated
  • Customer engagement and satisfaction
  • Increased awareness and utilization of RPA services

Position Objective The ultimate objective of this position is to grow the RPA program by connecting DHA organizations with automation solutions that address real business challenges.

The Customer Engagement Specialist will help organizations recognize where automation can provide value, connect those opportunities with the RPA Team, and build a sustainable pipeline of automation projects that reduce administrative burden and return valuable time to the DHA workforce.

The measure of success is not simply how many customers hear about RPA—it is how many meaningful automation opportunities move from conversation to implementation.

title: Physical Security Specialist III
description:

JOB SUMMARY

Job Profile Summary

The Physical Security Specialist is an experienced individual contributor within the ONEOK Security team. This position is responsible for supporting regulatory security programs, investigating physical security events, coordinating contract security services, and developing practical recommendations to reduce risk.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Contribute individual expertise and inclusive support to team priorities while sharing information, assisting colleagues, and collaborating to advance Physical Security objectives.
  • Lead and document assigned regulatory security program duties as an individual contributor, identify opportunities for security improvements, and develop practical recommendations for risk reduction.
  • Manage and investigate physical security events, including coordination with law enforcement agencies when appropriate.
  • Develop, review, and distribute investigation reports.
  • Conduct comprehensive interviews to gather, evaluate, document, and report information related to security events and investigations.
  • Coordinate contract security officer staffing across multiple facilities in alignment with directed initiatives.
  • Use security technology, reporting systems, and authorized investigative or intelligence resources to support investigations and strengthen company security.
  • Integrate with company personnel during training, drills, and emergency response activities as directed by leadership.
  • Serve as a physical security subject matter resource for project-planning teams; develop security recommendations for construction projects and future company assets.
  • Represent Physical Security in an assigned region of company operations and maintain productive working relationships with field personnel and cross-functional partners.

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience acquired through ten+ years in law enforcement, military or physical security preferred
  • Experience interacting, directing, advising and communicating professionally and effectively
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Office applications to generate electronic communications, documents, spreadsheets, and presentations

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of: security operations and procedures
  • Ability to: identify critical issues quickly, accurately and resolve in a timely manner
  • Ability to: react well under pressure
  • Ability to: maintain professional composure when dealing with unusual circumstances
  • Ability to: think and act independently, possess strong reasoning and problem-solving skills and make sound and timely decisions
  • Ability to: write routine correspondence, including logs and reports
  • Ability to: effectively communicate and/or exchange information; conduct oral presentations

Strength Factor Rating - Physical Demands/Requirements

  • Light Work - Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly (Constantly: activity or condition exists 2/3 or more of the time) to move objects. Physical demand requirements are in excess of those for Sedentary Work. Even though the weight lifted may be only a negligible amount, a job should be rated Light Work: (1) when it requires walking or standing to a significant degree; or (2) when it requires sitting most of the time but entails pushing and/or pulling of arm or leg controls; and/or (3) when the job requires working at a production rate pace entailing the constant pushing and/or pulling of materials even though the weight of those materials is negligible. NOTE: The constant stress and strain of maintaining a production rate pace, especially in an industrial setting, can be and is physically demanding of a worker even though the amount of force exerted is negligible.

Strength Factor Description - Physical Demands/Requirements

  • Standing: Remaining on one's feet in an upright position at a work station without moving about (Occasionally)
  • Walking: Moving about on foot, often for extended periods (Frequently)
  • Sitting: Remaining in a seated position (Frequently)

title: Senior Engineer, EDT Data & Analytics Cloud Engineering
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid

Senior Engineer, EDT Data & Analytics Cloud Engineering

The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer supports the operational excellence, security, and reliability of the enterprise data & analytics platform on Azure. The role combines platform operations, DevOps automation, and Infrastructure as Code across the core stack - Azure Databricks, Synapse, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and Unity Catalog - with a reliability-engineering mindset: automate repeatable work, apply security best practices by default, and help keep the platform highly available for global data engineering and analytics teams.

What you will do:

​​DevOps Pipeline Management & CI/CD

  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for CI/CD, automating build, test, and deployment across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Support high service availability through solid workflow management, smooth promotion processes, and efficient pipeline operations.

Infrastructure as Code & Environment Provisioning ​

  • Implement and maintain platform infrastructure as code using Terraform, ensuring consistent, repeatable provisioning and configuration across environments.
  • Provision and maintain environments — workspaces, compute, storage, networking, and access — using automated IaC processes, and help identify configuration drift.

Platform Security & Access Management

  • Support platform security alongside development and operations teams — implementing RBAC, access controls, and security configurations across Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, and Unity Catalog.
  • Apply Azure data service security best practices, including secrets management, identity integration, and least-privilege access.

Platform Operations & Reliability Engineering

  • Contribute to platform monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response, with a focus on root-cause analysis and preventive fixes.
  • Monitor integration runtimes and platform services, troubleshooting pipeline and runtime issues to help protect SLAs.

Data Engineering Operations

  • Partner with Data Platform and Data Product teams to build and operationalize data pipelines, orchestration, and Databricks workloads.

What you need:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related technical field, with 2-5 years of experience in cloud engineering, data warehousing, or modern data & analytics platforms.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Azure data technologies, including Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and Unity Catalog.
  • Proven experience implementing Azure platform security, governance, and data service best practices to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions.
  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline management, with experience automating deployments and releases across multiple environments.
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to provision, manage, and standardize cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience monitoring and optimizing cloud data platforms, including alerting, performance tuning, incident management, and root cause analysis.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify patterns, resolve complex technical issues, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive mindset for ownership, automation, and process optimization while partnering effectively across engineering, operations, security, and business teams.
  • Cloud Engineering certifications on Azure/Databricks platform is a plus.

description:
Whether you’re a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

Why Rosendin?

Committed. Innovative. Engaged.

If you’re looking to take career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. Rosendin is one of the largest electrical contractors in the United States employing over 7,000 people. We are the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED company in the industry which means you will be a company owner too and have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.

YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:

The Senior Estimator is responsible for preparing and completing bid/submittal documents and cost estimates for electrical construction projects. The Senior Estimator is the Lead Estimator for projects and works with other Estimators, suppliers, and customers to complete the estimate.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Prepare estimate from quantity take-off on project and complete estimate to computer printout.

  • Identify parts of project that may be key to making a competitive estimate.

  • Review proposal specifications, drawings, and attend pre-bid meetings to determine scope of work and required contents of estimate.

  • Evaluate areas for potential value engineering cost savings.

  • Provide leadership to personnel preparing discipline sub estimates for assigned bids.

  • Ensure all working documents and data are maintained to back-up estimate figures.

  • Develop labor productivity and (installation unit costs where applicable) based on projected site conditions and historical data.

  • Prepare detailed listing of material and equipment items for the estimate and to obtain quotes.

  • Identify qualified suppliers/subcontractors and be responsible for soliciting quotes. Review quotes for completeness and conformance with plans and specs.

  • Responsible for the timely completion of all client-required documents.

  • Draft scope/proposal letters for bid and negotiated projects.

  • Prior to the issuing of the formal bid package, provide the Chief Estimator with a detailed review of scope, technical requirements, and pricing for the estimated bid package.

  • After the successful bid at project turnover, meet with the Project Management departments to fully explain job scope, potential areas of attention and other aspects for the successful transition of the project.

  • Maintain files of all working documents to back-up estimate figures and update the Rosendin approved estimating program.

  • The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the position’s role within the business unit.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

  • Read and interpret blueprints and/or engineering design drawings

  • Perform arithmetic calculations required for estimating

  • Estimate all types of projects and to coordinate and supervise group work effort essential

  • Mentor and assist with the development of Estimators

  • Identify and meet customers’ needs, expectations, and requirements

  • Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (, Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.)

  • Prioritize and manage multiple tasks and change priorities as necessary

  • Work under pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude

  • Oral and written communication skills as required for the position

  • Self-motivated, proactive and an effective team player

  • Interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others

WHAT YOU BRING TO US:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field

  • Minimum 4 years’ estimating or other relevant experience in closing constructions estimates

  • Experience in Accubid estimating software, Livecount Cloud, and Bluebeam software preferred

  • Experience in CAD or 3D software preferred

  • Can be a combination of education, training, and relevant experience

TRAVEL:

  • Up to 10%

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • General work environment - sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.

  • Noise level is typically low to medium; it can be loud on a job site.

  • Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.

  • We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions.

YOU Matter – Our Benefits

  • ESOP – Employee Stock Ownership

  • 401k

  • Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement

  • 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance

  • Term Life, AD&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance

  • Disability Income Protection Insurance

Pay Range

$128,000.00-$167,900.00 Annual

The pay range for this role is what we expect to pay for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this job description. Candidate’s pay can vary based on location, job-related experience, skills, and education.

title: Assistant Manager, IT Support and Customer Experience
description:
ABOUT US

The Howard County Public School System (HCPSS) is one of the leading school systems in Maryland and the nation. To learn more about us and our 2024 -2029 Strategic Plan, please visit our website and our careers page. Join our award-winning workforce and make a difference in the lives of our students!

ABOUT THE APPLICATION PROCESS

Before you begin, please read the job posting below carefully including the Application Requirements specific to this position. Be sure your application reflects experience and education required to meet the minimum and any preferred qualifications listed. Our application guide includes detailed instructions to assist you. Once your application has been submitted, you will not be able to add documentation or make any changes.

Please note that application submission will be available only through 11:59 PM on the date prior to the indicated end date. If no end date is indicated, the posting will remain open indefinitely.

Job Posting End Date:

10-06-2026

Reminder: Current permanent and temporary employees must apply through the Jobs Hub in Workday, not the external career site.


DESCRIPTION


Under the direction of the Manager of IT Support and Customer Experience, the Assistant Manager provides operational leadership for the Technology Field Services Department, overseeing the delivery of on-site technical support services across the school system. This hands-on leadership role directs the daily work of IT Support Technicians responsible for supporting technology in schools and administrative offices, including computers, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, instructional technology, audio-visual systems, software deployment, and related technology services.

The Assistant Manager coordinates district-wide field support operations, workforce scheduling, equipment and parts management, and service delivery while serving as a primary liaison among schools, district offices, vendors, contractors, and internal technology teams. Through effective leadership, operational oversight, technical expertise, and continuous process improvement, this position ensures technology services are delivered efficiently, consistently, and professionally while maintaining high standards for customer experience, asset accountability, safety, and operational excellence.

This position fosters a customer-focused culture by promoting responsive service, proactive communication, standardized support practices, and continuous improvement to ensure reliable technology services that enable teaching, learning, and district operations.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


A combination of education and experience may be considered.


Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Experience:

  • Five (5) years of diagnosing, repairing, and/or supporting desktop computers, laptops, Chromebooks, and related technology equipment including the below:
  • Experience using an IT service management (ITSM) or work order system.
  • Experience supporting, configuring, maintaining, or troubleshooting one or more of the following technologies: audiovisual systems, classroom instructional technology, presentation systems, auditorium sound systems, digital signage, or video production equipment.
  • Experience coordinating or prioritizing multiple technical support requests within a high-volume support environment.
  • Experience delivering customer service in a technical support environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate for this role will also possess a combination of the additional qualifications below. If you don’t meet every one of the preferred qualifications, we still encourage you to apply, as we welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

  • Experience leading technical projects, coordinating work assignments, or providing technical guidance to others.
  • Experience supporting technology within a multi-site K–12 educational organization.
  • Experience overseeing vendor and contractor relationships.
  • Experience supervising, training, or mentoring technical support staff.
  • Experience supporting enterprise networking technologies, including TCP/IP, wireless connectivity, and network-connected devices.
  • Experience interpreting technical documentation, manufacturer service manuals, or engineering specifications.
  • Experience serving as the lead or primary coordinator for a technology deployment, implementation, or operational project.
  • Experience coordinating multiple technology projects, service requests, or operational priorities simultaneously.
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, Dell, Lenovo, Apple, Google Workspace, ITIL Foundation, or project management certifications.

ESSENTIAL POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

The below list is a summary of the functions of the job, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks, and duties.

  • Supervise and provide daily leadership to IT Support Technicians.
  • Assign daily work, establish priorities, and coordinate field service activities.
  • Review technician workloads and balance assignments to ensure timely and equitable service delivery.
  • Monitor employee productivity, work quality, and adherence to departmental performance expectations.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop staff to improve technical skills, customer service, and professional growth.
  • Assist with employee evaluations, disciplinary actions, and performance improvement efforts.
  • Participate in recruitment, interviewing, hiring recommendations, and onboarding of new employees.
  • Monitor attendance, approve leave requests, and maintain appropriate staffing levels.
  • Assist with operational planning, resource allocation, and departmental projects.
  • Assist in developing departmental goals, procedures, and service standards.
  • Recommend process improvements to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate district-wide technology deployments and field service projects.
  • Coordinate with schools, district offices, vendors, contractors, and internal technology teams to support technology initiatives and operational needs.
  • Assist in managing equipment, inventory, and operational resources.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for best practices and procedures.

Employee Safety

  • The employee is responsible for the use of safety devices and protective equipment in order to minimize the frequency and severity of work-related accidents. The employee is responsible for using safe practices and methods in the operation and supplies related to their job.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

The below list is a summary of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for success in this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list.

Knowledge

  • Safety Regulations & Standards: In-depth understanding of workplace safety compliance, environmental health standards, and regional regulations, including Maryland Occupational Safety and Health (MOSH).
  • Warranty & Vendor Management: Technical knowledge of warranty claim processes, service-level agreements, and coordinating third-party vendor repairs and maintenance.
  • Inventory & Asset Management: Strong grasp of inventory tracking systems, asset lifecycle management, auditing procedures, and stock optimization.

Skills

  • Leadership & Team Development: Skilled in mentoring staff, delegating responsibilities, fostering team collaboration, and driving individual and collective performance.
  • Customer Service Excellence: Exceptional service delivery with a strong focus on client satisfaction, query resolution, and maintaining long-term client relationships.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience diagnosing, isolating, and resolving mechanical, electrical, or system-level issues efficiently.
  • Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Analytical approach to evaluating complex operational challenges and delivering effective, root-cause solutions.
  • Project Planning & Organization: Expertise in defining project scope, establishing milestones, allocating resources, and executing workflows smoothly.
  • Conflict Resolution & Decision Making: Sound judgment in de-escalating team or client disputes and making prompt, data-informed operational decisions under pressure. bottlenecks, streamlining procedures, and implementing lean workplace strategies.
  • Professional Communication: Clear, effective verbal and written communication across all organization levels, vendor networks, and customer touchpoints.

Abilities

  • Physical Capabilities: Physical stamina and strength required to navigate job sites, climb ladders, maneuver in tight spaces, and safely lift or shift heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
  • Time Management & Prioritization: Ability to multitask, manage competing deadlines, and maintain high standards of precision in high-volume settings.
  • Adaptability & Change Management: Resilience and flexibility when navigating shifting priorities, dynamic workplace environments, or new operational processes.
  • Accountability & Integrity: Proven commitment to ethical conduct, operational transparency, and taking full ownership of project outcomes and safety protocols.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Proficiency in identifying operational

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

Licensure

  • Possession of a Maryland Class C driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

Prior to any employment offer, the selected candidate will need to provide a copy of their license and consent to a review of their driving record. For positions requiring a CDL, a query of your record will also be run in the Federal Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Complete applications must be submitted, and once your application has been submitted, you will not be able to add documentation or make any changes. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of a completed application.

Supplemental Application Questions

This position requires applicants to provide responses to the below supplemental application questions to determine whether you meet the minimum and preferred qualifications. Please upload your responses in a separate file to the supplemental application questions section of the application.

  • Describe a large-scale technology or infrastructure project you led, managed, or assisted from initiation to completion. In your response, describe the primary objectives of the project.

How did you plan, coordinate, and lead resources and stakeholders to completion, and what quantitative or qualitative metrics measured its ultimate success?

SELECTION CRITERIA

Applicants who meet the minimum qualifications will be included in further evaluation. Interviews will be limited to those applicants who, in addition to meeting the basic requirements, have experience and education which most closely match the position qualifications and the needs of the school system.

Applicants may be required to complete a skills assessment prior to or during the interview process.

EMPLOYMENT INFORMATION

Compensation

This is a 12-month per year position in the Howard County Association of Supervisors and Administrators-Administrators, Non-Certificated Supervisors (HCASA-NCS) employee unit. The current salary range for this position is in the Grade II lane on the Non-Certificated Supervisors salary scale. Actual placement will be in accordance with the salary procedures of the Howard County Public School System and the HCASA-NCS Master Agreement which considers relevant prior experience. Under the Fair Labor Standards Act, this position is exempt from overtime.

Retirement

Membership in the Maryland State Retirement Agency (MSRA) pension plan is a mandatory condition of employment for all employees who meet the eligibility and membership criteria defined in the State Personnel and Pensions Article and the Code of Maryland Regulations (COMAR). A qualifying employee cannot reject membership, nor can an ineligible employee elect membership. The annual contribution to the pension plan will be 7% of an employee’s annual salary.

Benefits

HCPSS offers a comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees. Information about additional benefits such as paid time off can be found in the negotiated agreement for employees in this bargaining unit.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Professional references will be contacted prior to any offer of employment. Recommended candidates will be required to provide references from current and recent supervisors.

All employees, regular and temporary, must be fingerprinted, have a criminal background investigation completed, and successfully complete the Maryland Employment History Review, pursuant to Section 6-113.2 of the Education Article, Annotated Code of Maryland. In addition, some positions will require completion of a physical examination and/or drug testing.

Anyone offered employment is required to provide proper identification and documentation of eligibility for employment in the United States. HCPSS participates in E-Verify and does not offer employee sponsorship.

title: Grossing Technician (part-time)
description:
Overview

Grossing Technician - Part Time

Anne Arundel Dermatology is seeking an experienced part-time Grossing Technician to join the pathology laboratory within our Academic Alliance in Dermatology practice.

This is a part-time position working approximately 3 hours per day. The ideal candidate will have previous hands-on grossing experience and be comfortable supporting specimen preparation and documentation in a fast-paced pathology laboratory.

Schedule: Approximately 3 hours per day. Hours are flexible, with a preferred start time around 10:00 AM or during normal daytime laboratory hours. Late-afternoon availability may also be considered.

Why join Anne Arundel Dermatology?

We are committed to continual training and education for our physicians and staff. We are on top of the latest developments in dermatology including ongoing research, emerging treatments, new medications and prevention methods. You can find more than just a job with Anne Arundel Dermatology. We believe in providing our new associates with intensive hands on training and long-term career growth opportunities from within.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Perform gross examination and preparation of tissue specimens for histologic processing.

  • Accurately measure, describe, section, label, and prepare specimens according to established laboratory procedures.

  • Document gross descriptions and specimen information accurately and completely.

  • Ensure proper specimen identification, handling, and tracking throughout the grossing process.

  • Maintain accurate specimen logs and laboratory documentation.

  • Collaborate with pathologists, histotechnicians, and other laboratory team members to support efficient daily workflow.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and properly stocked grossing area.

  • Follow laboratory safety, quality, and compliance standards.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Previous hands-on specimen grossing experience required.

  • Experience working in a pathology, histology, dermatopathology, or similar laboratory environment strongly preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of proper specimen handling, identification, and documentation.

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently while maintaining accuracy.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with pathologists and laboratory staff.

  • Science-related education or laboratory training preferred.

Licensure/Certifications/Education

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a healthcare or administrative role preferred.
  • Bachelor of Science degree required (Biology, Chemistry, or related science field preferred)
  • Minimum of 24 completed credit hours in science courses (biology, chemistry, anatomy, etc.)

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
